9-14. vēntūr ............. peṟupakol
uri :
vēntūr yāṉi veṇkōṭu koṇṭu - paki vēntar ēṟippōnta kaḷiṟṟiṉik koṉṟu ataṉ maruppiṉik kikkoṇṭu; kaṭkoṭi nuṭaṅkum āvaṇam uṭaṉpukku - kaḷḷukkaṭiyiṉ koṭi yacintutōṉṟum kaṭit teruvi uṭaṉaṭintu; aruṅ kaḷ noṭimi tīrnta piṉ - ariya kaḷḷukku viliyākat tantu ak kaḷḷip peṟṟuṇṭa piṉpu; makiḻ ciṟantu - makiḻcci mikku; nāmam aṟiyā ēma vāḻkki vaṭapula vāḻnariṉ - accatti yaṟiyāta iṉpamē nukarum vāḻkkiyiyuṭiya uttarakuruvil vāḻum makkaḷip pōla; peritu amarntu - mikka viruppamuṟṟu; alkalum iṉṉaki mēya pal uṟi peṟupa kol - nāṭōṟum iṉiya uvaki poruntiyuṟiyum poḻutukaḷ pala peṟuvār kaḷō; peṟutal aritu pōlum eṉṟavāṟu.
pōrillāta kālattē cēraṉuṭiya vīrar kālaṅkaḻikkum tiṟam kūṟuvār, nāṭōṟum avarkaḷ pakippulattē paki vēntar ūrntuvarum kaḷiṟṟiṉik koṉṟu, koṇarnta avaṟṟiṉ veṇkōṭukaḷik kaḷḷiṟku viliyākat tantu, kaḷḷip peṟṟu makiḻvatu kūṟuvār, “veṇkōṭu koṇṭu āvaṇam pukku aruṅkaḷ noṭimi tīrntapiṉ makiḻ ciṟantu” eṉṟār. veṇkōṭṭuk kaḷiṟukaḷil ciṟappuṭiyavaṟṟiyē vēntar ūrntu celpavātaliṉ ac ciṟappuṭimi tōṉṟa, “vēntūr yāṉi veṇkōṭu” eṉṟār. kaḷḷukkaṭiyil koṭikaṭṭi vittal ikkālattiṟ pōlap paṇṭik kālattum uṇmi yaṟika; neṭuṅkoṭi nuṭaṅkum naṟavu mali maṟukil” (akam. 126) eṉṟu piṟarum kūṟupa. uyarnta kōṭukaḷit tantallatu peṟalākāmi tōṉṟa. “aruṅkaṇ ṇoṭimi” yeṉṟār. eṉavē, kaḷḷiṉatu iṉippum kaḷippum kūṟiyavā ṟāyiṟṟu. kaṭkaṭikku vīrar tam tōḻarōṭaṉṟit taṉittuc cellā reṉṟaṟku “uṭaṉ pukku” eṉṟār. “mataṉuṭi vēḻattu veṇkōṭu koṇṭu, poṉṉuṭi niyamattup piḻinoṭi koṭukkum” (patiṟ. 30) eṉṟu piṟarum kūṟutal kāṇka.
vaṭapulam eṉṟatu uttarakuru veṉappaṭum; aṅku vāḻvōr paki mutaliya kāraṇamākap piṟakkum accam yātumiṉṟi iṉpamē tuyttiruppa veṉpavākaliṉ, “nāma maṟiyā vēma vāḻkki, vaṭapula vāḻnariṉ” eṉṟār. paḻiya vurikārarum, “nāma maṟiyā ēma vāḻkki yeṉṟatu, tuṉpam iṭiviraviṉa iṉpamaṉṟi iṭiyaṟāta iṉpamēyāyc cēṟalāṉa vāḻkki yeṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “ic ciṟappāṉē itaṟku ēma vāḻkki yeṉṟu peyarāyiṟ” ṟeṉṟum, “vaṭapulam, pōka pūmiyākiya uttarakuru” eṉṟum kūṟuvar. itaṉi “aruntavaṅ koṭukkuñ curuṅkāc celvattu, uttara kuruvam” (peruṅ. 2 : 7: 140-1) eṉṟu koṅkuvēḷir kūṟutal kāṇka. iṉṉaki: iṉiya iṉpam eṉpatu paḻiyavuri. uṟi, ākupeyarāl uṟiyum poḻutiṉ mēlatāyiṟṟu. uṟi peṟutal aritu pōlum eṉpatu kuṟippu. eṉavē, vēntaṉ nāṭōṟum pōrvēṭṭu viṉipuritaliyē mēṟkoṇ ṭiruntami peṟṟām.
itukāṟum kūṟiyatu: aṇaṅkeḻil ariviyarp piṇik kum mārpa, niṉ tāṇiḻal vāḻvōr, kaṭṭūr nāppaṇ, muracam atira, uṇṇā taṭukkiyapoḻutu pala kaḻiyavum, iṉṉār uṟiyuḷ tām peṟiṉallatu, alkalum peritamarntu, vaṭapulavāḻnariṉ iṉṉaki mēya palluṟi, peṟupa kollō; peṟutal aritu pōlum eṉa viṉimuṭivu ceyka. iṉip paḻiyavurikārar, ariviyarp piṇikkum maṇam kamaḻ mārpa, niṉ tāḷniḻalōr uṇṇā taṭukkiya poḻutu pala kaḻiya iṉṉār uṟiyuḷ tām peṟiṉaṉṟi, iṉṉaki alkalum mēya palluṟi peṟupakol? peṟār; avar avvāṟu atu peṟiṉaṉṟi niṉ mārpāṟ piṇikkappaṭṭa ariviyarum iṉṉaki alkalum mēya palluṟi peṟuvatu ētu eṉak kūṭṭi viṉimuṭivu ceyka” eṉpar.
“itaṉāṟ colliyatu: kāma vēṭkiyiṉ ōṭāta avaṉ veṉṟi vēṭkicciṟappuk kūṟiyavāṟāyiṟṟu.”
9. maṇkeḻu ñālam
1.	maliyuṟaḻ yāṉi vāṉṟōy velkoṭi
	varimici yaruviyiṉ vayiṉvayi ṉuṭaṅkak
	kaṭalpō ṟāṉik kaṭuṅkuraṉ muracam
	kāluṟu kaṭaliṟ kaṭiya vuraṟa
5.	eṟintu citinta vāḷ
	iliterinta vēl
	pāyntāynta mā
	āyntuterinta pukaṉmaṟavaroṭu
	paṭupiṇam piṟaṅka nūṟip pakivar
10.	keṭukuṭi payiṟṟiya koṟṟa vēntē
	niṉpōl, acivil koḷkiya rākali ṉaciyātu
	āṇṭōr maṉṟavim maṇkeḻu ñālam
	nilampayam poḻiyac cuṭarciṉan taṇiyap
	payaṅkeḻu veḷḷi yāniya niṟpa
15.	vicumpumey yakalap peyalpura vetira
	nālvēṟu naṉantali yōrāṅku nanta
	ilaṅkukatirt tikiri muntici ṉōrē.
tuṟi	:	vañcittuṟip pāṭāṇpāṭṭu
vaṇṇam	:	oḻuku vaṇṇamum coṟcīr vaṇṇamum
tūkku	:	centūkkum vañcittūkkum
peyar	:	maṇkeḻu ñālam
1-10. maliyuṟaḻ ........... vēntē
uri:
mali yuṟaḻ yāṉi vāṉ tōy velkoṭi - mali pōlum yāṉiyiṉmēl vāṉaḷāva eṭutta veṟṟikkoṭi yāṉatu; varimici yaruviyiṉ - malimēliruntu viḻum aruvi pōla; vayiṉ vayiṉ nuṭaṅka - iṭantōṟum acintu viḷaṅka; kaṭalpōl tāṉik kaṭuṅkural muracam - kaṭal pōṉṟa tāṉiyiṉ naṭuvē kaṭiya muḻakkattiyuṭiya muracu; kāl uṟu kaṭaliṉ kaṭiya uraṟa - kāṟṟāl mōtappaṭṭa kaṭalpōlak kaṭitāy muḻaṅka; eṟintu citinta vāḷ - pakivari eṟitalāl citivuṟṟa vāḷ vīrarum; ili terinta vēl - ilipōṉṟa taliyiyuṭiya valiya vēlēntiya vīrarum; pāyntu āynta mā - pakivarmēṟ pāytalāl ōyvuṟṟa kutirikaḷum; āyntu terinta pukal maṟavaroṭu - ārāyntu terintukoḷḷappaṭṭa pōrvēṭkiyiṉiyuṭiya 
vīrarkaḷum koṇṭa tāṉiyuṭaṉ ceṉṟu; paṭu piṇam piṟaṅkap pakivar nūṟi - pōrilē paṭṭu vīḻum piṇaṅkaḷ kuvintu uyarap pakivarik koṉṟaḻittu; keṭu kuṭi payiṟṟiya - avar nāṭṭil keṭṭōruṭiya kuṭikaḷi vāḻacceyta: koṟṟa vēntē - veṟṟi vēntaṉē eṉṟavāṟu.
yāṉikku maliyum koṭikku aruviyum uvamamāyiṉa. “peruvari yiḻitarum neṭuveḷ ḷaruvi, ōṭi yāṉiyuyar mici yeṭutta, āṭu koṭi kaṭuppat tōṉṟum” (akam.358) eṉṟu piṟarum kūṟutal kāṇka. “uravukkaṭa laṉṉa tāṅkarun tāṉiyoṭu” (patiṟ. 90) eṉṟu piṟarum kūṟutalpōla, īṇṭum āciriyar “kaṭalpōl tāṉi” yeṉṟār. kēṭṭa pakivar uḷḷattē accattip payattal paṟṟik “kaṭuṅkural muracam” eṉṟār. “eṟintu citinta vā” ḷeṉṟum, “pāyntāynta mā” eṉṟum kūṟiyatu, muṟiyē vāṭpaṭi, kutirip paṭi kaḷiṉ pōrp payiṟciyiṉ ciṟappuk kuṟittu niṉṟaṉa. vāḷ, vēl, kutiri yeṉpaṉa, avvavaṟṟi yāḷum tāṉi vīraric cuṭṭi niṉṟaṉa. oṭuviṉi vāḷ mutaliyavaṟṟōṭum kūṭṭuka. āytal, ōytal. pala pōrkaḷilum aṟam piḻiyātu veṉṟu mēmpaṭṭāriyē vīrarāka ārāyntu tērntu kōṭaliṉ, “āyntu terinta maṟava” reṉṟum, avartāmum ap pōriṭip peṟum pukaḻē virumpi niṟṟal paṟṟip “pukal maṟava” reṉṟum kūṟiṉār.
iṉip paḻiyavurikārar, “nuṭaṅka eṉavum uraṟa eṉavum niṉṟa viṉiyeccaṅkaḷi nūṟi yeṉṉum viṉiyoṭu muṭikka” eṉṟum, “pukaṉ maṟavaroṭu eṉṉum oṭuvi, vāḷoṭu, vēloṭu, māvoṭu eṉa eṅkum kūṭṭuka” eṉṟum, “vāḷ, vēl, mā eṉa niṉṟa mūṉṟum ākupeya” reṉṟum kūṟuvar.
ik kūṟiya tāṉiyoṭu ceṉṟu etirnta pakivarit tākki veṉṟi mikum tiṟatti, “paṭupiṇam piṟaṅka nūṟi” eṉṟār. poṭipaṭutta leṉṉum poruṭṭāya nuṟi yeṉṉum col īṇṭuk kōṟaṟ poruṭṭu. paḻiyavuriyum, “nūṟi yeṉpatu īṇṭuk koṉṟeṉṉum poruṇmittu,” eṉṟal kāṇka.
pōril paṭṭu vīḻum piṇaṅkaḷ peruki malipōlak kuviyap porutalāl, pakivar nāṭu kuṭivaḷam kuṉṟik keṭutalāl, tītu kaṭintu naṉṟu purakkum vēntaṟku, keṭṭa kuṭiyi nalamuṟuvittup pēṇutal kaṭaṉātaliṉ, atu ceyta vēntaṉi, “keṭukuṭi payiṟṟiya koṟṟa vēntē” yeṉṟār, “paṭupiṇam piṟaṅkap pakivari nūṟiya piṉ ap pakivaruṭiya keṭṭuppōṉa kuṭimakkaḷi avar nāṭṭilē payiṉṟu vāḻ vārākap paṇṇiya” veṉṟum, “iṉip pakivaruṭiya keṭṭa kuṭikaḷi vēṟṟunāṭṭilē payilappaṇṇiṉa veṉṟumā” meṉṟum paḻiyavurikārar kūṟuvar.
13-17. nilam ................. munticiṉōrē
uri :
nilam payam poḻiya - nilam taṉpāl viḷiyum viḷi poruḷkaḷi mika viḷivikka; cuṭar ciṉam taṇiya - veyilatu vemmi varampikavātu taṇintu nilava; payam keḻu veḷḷi āniya niṟpa - ulakiṟku nalla payaṉic ceyyum veḷḷi yeṉṉum kōḷ maḻikkuk kāraṇamākiya ēṉi nāḷ kōḷkaḷuṭaṉē ceṉṟu niṟpa; vicumpu meyyakalap peyal puravu etira - vāṉam maḻi mukilkaḷ nirampap paravi nalla maḻiyip peyvatu kāraṇamāka iṭam akaṉṟu viḷaṅkavē maḻi taṉ peyalāl ulaku purakkum ceyaluṟṟu niṟpa; nālvēṟu naṉantali - nāṉkāy vēṟupaṭṭa akaṉṟa ticiyiṭa mellām; ōrāṅku nanta - oṉṟupōla ākka meyta; ilaṅku katirt tikiri munticiṉōr - viḷaṅkukiṉṟa aracavāṇiyākiya tikiriyic celuttiya niṉ muṉṉōr eṉṟavāṟu.
taṉpāl viḷiporuḷi mika viḷittu vaḻaṅkumāṟu paṟṟi, “nilam payam poḻiya” eṉṟum, veyilatu vemmiyum maḻi kālantōṟum peytalāl varampikavātu nilavuta lālum, varam pikanta vemmiyē uyirkaḷāl mikutiyākak karutappaṭu mātalālum, “cuṭar ciṉam taṇiya” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. veḷḷikkōḷ ulakuyirkaṭku nalam ceyyumākaliṉ, “payaṅ keḻu veḷḷi” yeṉṟum, annalam uṇṭātaṟkut tuṇi yākum ēṉi nāḷum kōḷum iyaṅkumiṭattē ivveḷḷi niṟka vēṇṭutaliṉ, “āniyam niṟpa” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. “aḻal ceṉṟa maruṅkiṉ veḷḷiyō ṭātu, maḻivēṇṭu pulattu māri niṟpa” (patiṟ. 13) eṉṟum, “vaṟitu vaṭakkiṟiñciya cīrcāl veḷḷi, payaṅkeḻu poḻutō ṭāniya niṟpa” (patiṟ. 24) eṉṟum cāṉṟōr kūṟutal kāṇka.
iṉip paḻiyavurikārar, “nilam payam poḻiya veṉṟatu, cilar aracu ceyyuṅ kālaṅkaḷil maḻiyum nīrum kuṟiviṉṟi yiruntum evviḷivum curuṅka viḷiyum kālamum uḷavām; avvāṟaṉṟi nilam payaṉip poḻintāṟpōla mika viḷiya veṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, cuṭar ciṉam taṇiya veṉṟatu, “tiṅkaḷ mummāriyum peytu maḻi iṭiyaṟātu varukiṉṟamiyiṉ cuṭar ciṉam taṇintāṟ pōṉṟa tōṟṟa meṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “veḷḷi yeṉṟatu vaṟitu vaṭakkiṟiñciya cīrcāl veḷḷi yeṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “payaṅkeḻu āniya niṟka veṉṟatu, av veḷḷi maḻikku uṭalāṉa maṟṟi nāḷkōḷkaḷukkuc celkiṉṟa nalla nāḷkaḷilē  niṟka veṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum kūṟuvar.
āṭci nalam ilvaḻi, maḻiyiṉmikkuk kāraṇamākiya nāḷum kōḷum nili tiritaliṉ, vicumpum iṭam curuṅkit taṭumāṟumeṉpatu paṟṟi, “vicumpu meyyakala” eṉṟum, ataṉāl maḻi vēṇṭuṅ kālattu viḷivu mikutik kēṟpap peytu ulakuyirkaṭku nalam ceytalāl, “peyalpura vetira” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. iṉip paḻiyavurikārar, “vicumpu meyyakala veṉṟatu, am maḻi yillāmikku uṟpātamākiya tūmat tōṟṟa miṉmiyiṉ, ākāyaveḷi taṉ vaṭivu paṇṭiyil akaṉṟāṟpōlat tōṉṟa veṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum kūṟuvar.
nāṟṟiciyum taṉittaṉi vēṟuvē ṟiyalpiṉavātalāl, “nālvēṟu naṉantali” yeṉṟum, iyalpu vēṟupaṭiṉum payaṉviḷitaṟkaṇ ēṟṟat tāḻviṉṟi oṉṟupōla ākkam eytiṉa eṉṟaṟku, “ōrāṅku nanta” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār; “nālu ticiyum oṉṟupōlē pakiyiṉṟi viḷaṅka” veṉpatu paḻiyavuri.
payam poḻiya, ciṉam taṇiya, āniyam niṟpa, peyal puravetira, ōrāṅku nanta, tikiri celuttiya munticiṉōr eṉa oru col varuvittu muṭikka. paḻiyavurikārar, poḻiya eṉpatu mutal nanta eṉpatu īṟāka niṉṟavaṟṟi “āṇṭōr” (aṭi. 12) eṉpataṉōṭu kūṭṭi muṭippār.
11-12. niṉpōl .............. ñālam
uri :
niṉpōl maṉṟa acivil koḷkiya rātaliṉ - niṉṉippōl teḷivāka māṟāta koḷkiyi yuṭiya varkaḷā yiruntamiyāl; im maṇkeḻu ñālam aciyātu āṇṭōr - ivvaṇuc ceṟinta nilavulakatti iṉitu āṇṭārkaḷ eṉṟavāṟu.
niṉ muṉṉōriṉum nī koḷkiyāl uyarntāy eṉpār, niṉ pōl eṉa uvamikkaṇ vittōtiṉār. avar varalāṟṟuk koḷkikaḷiyum niṉ koḷki kaḷiyum cīrtūkkik kāṇumiṭattē avaruṭiyavaṟṟiṉum niṉṉuṭiya koḷki mēmpaṭṭut tikaḻkiṉṟaṉa veṉpār, “maṉṟa” eṉṟār. acivu, mutalatu tiripiṉmēlum piṉṉatu varuttattiṉ mēlum niṉṟaṉa. mēlvarum paki mutaliya vaṟṟukku eḷimi yuṟṟu aracumuṟi tirital kūṭāteṉṟaṟku, “acivil koḷki” yeṉṟum, muṟi kōṭiyavaḻi, vaṟumi piṇi mutaliyaṉa nāṭṭiṟ peruki makkaṭku iṭumpi payattaliṉ, “aciyā tāṇṭōr” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār.
maṉṟa veṉpataṉi `acivil koḷkiyarātaliṉ’ eṉpataṉōṭu kūṭṭi yurikka. im maṇkeḻu ñālam eṉṟaṟkup paḻiya vurikārar, “poṉñāla maṉṟi im maṇñāla muḻutum āṇṭā reṉpatu tōṉṟa, maṇkeḻu ñālameṉṟa ic ciṟappāṉē itaṟku maṇkeḻuñāla meṉṟu peyarāyiṟ” ṟeṉpar.
itukāṟum kūṟiyatu: koṭi nuṭaṅka, muracam uraṟa, vāḷvīrar mutal maṟavar uḷḷiṭṭa tāṉiyoṭu ceṉṟu pakivar piṇam piṟaṅka nūṟi, avarnāṭṭuk keṭukuṭi payiṟṟiya vēntē, ilaṅkukatirt tikiri celuttiya niṉ munticiṉōr, niṉpōl acivil koḷkiyarātaliṉ, im maṇkeḻu ñālam aciyātu āṇṭārkaḷ eṉak kūṭṭi viṉimuṭipu ceyka. iṉip paḻiyavurikārar, “koṟṟa vēntē, ilaṅku katirt tikiriyiṉiyuṭiya niṉ muṉṉōr, niccayamāka niṉṉip pōl acivillāta mēṟkōḷiyuṭiyarā kiyālē, immaṇ ñālattiṉi nilam payam poḻital mutalāka nālvēṟu naṉantali ōrāṅku nanta eṉpatu īṟāka eṇṇappaṭṭa niṉ pukaḻellām uḷavāka aciviṉṟi āṇṭōrāvar; avaral lār immaṇñālattiṉ orō viṭaṅkaḷi āḷuvatallatu muḻutum āḷutal kūṭātaṉṟē yeṉak kūṭṭi viṉimuṭivu ceyka” eṉpar.
“āṇṭō raciyātu eṉpatu pāṭamākki ataṟkēṟpa urippārum uḷar. itaṉāṟ colliyatu avaṉ āḷviṉic ciṟappiṉi avaṉ kuṭivaralāṟṟoṭu paṭuttuc colliyavā ṟāyiṟṟu.”
“eṟintu citinta eṉpatu mutalāka maṟavaroṭu eṉpatu īṟāka nāṉkaṭi vañciyaṭiyāy vantamiyāṉ, vañcittūkku māyiṟṟu. avaṟṟuḷ muṉṉiṉṟa mūṉṟaṭikaḷiṉ īṟṟuccīrkaḷ aciccīrkaḷākavum, maṟṟi yaṭiyiṉ īṟṟuccīr” potuc cīrākavum iṭṭuk koḷka. niṉpōl eṉṟatu kūṉ.”
10. paṟikkura laruvi
1.	kaḷiṟukaṭiiya tāḷ
	māvuṭaṟṟiya vaṭimpu
	camantatinta vēl
	kallalitta tōḷ
5.	villalitta nalvalattu
	vaṇṭici kaṭāvāt taṇpaṉam pōnti
	kuvimuki ḻūci veṇṭōṭu koṇṭu
	tīñcuṉi nīrmalar milintumatañ cerukki
	uṭinili nallamar kaṭantu maṟaṅkeṭuttuk
10.	kaṭuñciṉa vēntar cemma ṟolitta
	valampaṭu vāṉkaḻal vayavar peruma
	nakiyiṉum poyyā vāymip pakivar
	puṟañcoṟ kēḷāp puritī roṇmip
	peṇmi cāṉṟu perumaṭa niliik
15.	kaṟpiṟi koṇṭa kamaḻuñ cuṭarnutaṟ
	puriyōḷ kaṇava pūṇkiḷar mārpa
	toliyāk koḷkic cuṟṟañ cuṟṟa
	vēḷviyiṟ kaṭavu ḷaruttiṉi kēḷvi
	uyarnili yulakat tiyariṉ puṟuttiṉi
20.	vaṇaṅkiya cāyal vaṇaṅkā vāṇmi
	iḷantuṇip putalvariṉ mutiyarp pēṇit
	tolkaṭa ṉiṟutta velpō raṇṇal
	māṭō ruṟiyu mulakamuṅ kēṭpa
	iḻumeṉa viḻitarum paṟikkura laruvi
25.	muḻumutaṉ miciya kōṭutoṟun tuvaṉṟum
	ayiri neṭuvari pōlat
	toliyā tākanī vāḻu nāḷē.
tuṟi	:	centuṟip pāṭāṇpāṭṭu
vaṇṇam	:	oḻuku vaṇṇam
tūkku	:	centūkkum vañcittūkkum
peyar	:	paṟikkura laruvi
1-5. kaḷiṟu ................. nalvalattu
uri :
kaḷiṟu kaṭiiya tāḷ - kaḷiṟukaḷi neṟiyaṟintu celuttip payiṉṟa tāḷiṉiyum; mā vuṭaṟṟiya vaṭimpu - kutirikaḷip porutaṟkuc celuttip payiṉṟa tāḷ
viḷimpiṉiyum; camam tatinta vēl - pakivar ceyyum pōrik keṭutta vēṟ paṭiyiṉiyum; kal alitta tōḷ - kalloṭu porutu payiṉṟa tōḷiṉiyum; vil alitta nalvalattu - villēntip porutu pakivari varuttiya nalla veṟṟiyiṉiyumuṭiya (vayavar. 11) eṉṟavāṟu.
kaḷiṟṟiṉmēlē yiruntu celuttum vīrar ataṉ piṭarik kaṇ irukkum kayiṟṟiṭiyē tam tāḷic ceruki muṉ tāḷāl tam kuṟippiṉi yuṇarttic celuttupa vātaliṉ, ac ciṟappuk kuṟittu, avar tāḷi, “kaḷiṟu kaṭiiya tāḷ” eṉṟār. kutiri mēliruntu porum kutiri vīrar, tam tāḷiṉ akaviḷimpāl, avaṟṟiṟkut tam kuṟippi yuṇarttic celuttupa vākaliṉ, acciṟappu nōkki, “māvuṭaṟṟiya vaṭimpu” eṉṟār. vaṭimpu, tāḷiṉ viḷimpu. vaṭimpalampa niṉṟa pāṇṭiyaṉ” eṉṉum vaḻakkuṇmi kāṇka. vēlum vāḷum eṉṟavaṟṟuḷ, vēl ciṟantamiyiṉ ataṉi yeṭuttōtiṉā rākaliṉ, vāḷ vaṉmiyum kūṟiyavāṟākak koḷka. iṉit tōḷvaṉmikku, kaṟṟūṇoṭu porutu maṟpayiṟci peṟṟuk  kāḻppuṟṟiruppatu kūṟuvār, “kallalitta tōḷ” eṉṟār. ivvāṟu paṭivīrarkku vēṇṭum ciṟappiyalkaḷuḷ kaḷiṟūrtal, māvūrtal, vēl vāṭpōr, maṟpayiṟci eṉpavaṟṟik kūṟi, vilvaṉmi iṉṟiyamiyāmi paṟṟi, “villalitta nalvalattu vayavar” eṉṟār.
iṉi, camam tatinta vēl eṉṟataṟku, “māṟṟār ceyyum camaṅkaḷ cititaṟkuk kāraṇamākiya vēleṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “vēleṉṟatu vēl veṉṟiyiṉi” yeṉṟum, “kallalitta tōḷeṉṟatu valiyuṭimiyāl kalli yalitta tōḷ eṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum paḻiyavurikārar kūṟuvar.
itaṉāl, tāḷiṉiyum vaṭimpiṉiyum vēṟpaṭi yiṉiyum, tōḷiṉiyum, villiṉiyu muṭiya vayavar eṉak kūṭṭi muṭikka.
6-11. vaṇṭici ............... peruma
uri :
vaṇṭici kaṭavā - vaṇṭiṉam moyttup pāṭutal illāta; taṇ paṉam pōnti - taṇṇiya paṉiyiṉatu; kuvi mukiḻ ūci veṇ tōṭu koṇṭu - kuvinta arumpu pōṉṟa kūrmiyiyuṭiya veḷḷiya paṉaṅkuruttōṭu; tīñcuṉi nīrmalar milintu - iṉiya cuṉiyiṭattu malarnta kuvaḷippū viraviya kaṇṇiyic cūṭi; matam cerukki - pōrkku vēṇṭum matam mikuntu; kaṭuñciṉa vēntar - mikka ciṉattiyuṭiya paki maṉṉar; uṭinili nal amar kaṭantu - eṉṟum tamakkē yuṭimiyākap peṟṟa nilimiyiṉiyuṭiya nalla pōrkaḷi vañciyātu porutaḻittu; maṟam keṭuttu - avaruṭiya pōrvaṉmiyic citittu; cemmal tolitta - iṟutiyāka avaratu talimiyiṉiyu maṟak keṭutta; valampaṭu vāṉkaḻal vayavar peruma - veṟṟi poruntiya periya kaḻalaṇinta vīrarkkut talivaṉē eṉṟavāṟu.
veṇtōṭu koṇṭu nīrmalar milintu, cerukki, kaṭantu, keṭuttu, tolitta vayavar eṉṟu kūṭṭi, avar kaṭkup peruma eṉa iyikka. vayavarperuma eṉpataṉi oru peyarākkic cēramāṉukkē ēṟṟi muṭippiṉumām.
paṉantōṭṭōṭu kuvaḷippūvi viravit toṭutta kaṇṇiyi yaṇivatu cēranāṭṭu vīrark kiyalpātalāl, īṇṭum ataṉi yeṭuttōtiṉār. paṉaṅkuruttil tēṉiṉmiyiṉ vaṇṭiṉam moyttup pāṭutal illi yātalāl, “vaṇṭici kaṭāvāt taṇpaṉam pōnti” yeṉṟum, ataṉi aḻakitākat toṭuttaṇintavaḻi, pū veṉṟu karuti mūcum vaṇṭiṉam vaṟitu mīḷāmipporuṭṭu, vēṟu kuvaḷi, vēṅki, vāki mutaliya pūkkaḷi viravit toṭuttaṇiyum iyalpiṉāl, “veṇtōṭu koṇṭu tīñcuṉi nīrmalar milintu” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. paṉaṅ kuruttāl kuvinta arumpupōla muṭintatu ūci pōlak kūritā yiruttal paṟṟi, “kuvi mukiḻ ūci veṇtōṭu” eṉpārāyiṉar. “vaṭkar pōkiya vaḷariḷam pōnti, uccik koṇṭa vūci veṇṭōṭu” (puṟam. 100) eṉṟu piṟarum kūṟutal kāṇka. tīñcuṉi nīrmalar eṉṟaṟku nīlamalar ciṟappuṭit tāyiṉum, kuvaḷip pūvē pōntiyiṟ ṟoṭukkum poṟ puṭimiyāl, atu koḷḷappaṭṭatu. “veṇtōṭ ṭacitta voṇpūṅ kuvaḷiyar” (patiṟ. 58) eṉṟu piṟarum kūṟupa. pōruṭaṟṟutalum ataṉkaṇ veṟṟi peṟutalum tamakku niliyākak koṇṭu ciṟakkum vēntareṉpār. paki vēntari, kaṭuñciṉa vēnta reṉṟum, “uṭinili nallamar” eṉṟum ciṟappittār. uṭinili yeṉpatu “uṭipperuñ celvam” (paḻa. 200) eṉpatu pōla niṉṟatu. ivviyalpiṉarāṉa vēntariyum veṉṟu aṭippaṭuttik koṇṭami tōṉṟa, “cemmal tolitta” eṉṟār. kāliṟ kaḻal yāppu veṟṟi peṟum vīrarkkē perumi tarutaliṉ, “valampaṭu vāṉkaḻal vayavar” eṉṟāreṉa vaṟika. veṉṟi peṟutaṟkuk kāraṇamāṉa ciṟanta kaḻaleṉpārumuḷar.
12-16. nakiyiṉum ............ mārpa
uri :
nakiyiṉum poyyā vāymi - viḷiyāṭṭāṉum poy kūṟutali yillāta vāymiyiṉiyum; pakivar puṟañcol kēḷā - pakivar tam puṟattē ikaḻntu kūṟum coṟkaḷi ēṟaṭṭukkoḷḷāta; puritīr oṇmi - kuṟṟam nīṅkiya aṟiviṉiyum; pūṇ kiḷar mārpa - pūṇāra maṇinta mārpiṉi yum uṭiyōy; peṇmi cāṉṟu - nāṇam niṟintu; peru maṭam nilii - periya maṭameṉṉum kuṇam nilipeṟṟu; kaṟpu iṟi koṇṭa - kaṟpuneṟikkaṇṇē taṅkiṉa; kamaḻum cuṭarnutal - maṇam kamaḻum oḷi poruntiya neṟṟiyiṉiyuṭiya; puriyōḷ kaṇava - uyarntavaṭkuk kaṇavaṉē eṉṟavāṟu.
poyyāmi, aṟam palavaṟṟuḷḷum ciṟantamiyuṇarntu ataṉi viḷiyāṭṭiṉum nekiḻātu ōmpum naṟpaṇpiṉi viyantu, “nakiyiṉum poyyā vāymi” eṉṟār. viḷiyāṭ ṭākak kūṟum poy yārkkum eṉṟum ettuṇiyum tīmi payavātāyiṉum koḷḷaṟpāla taṉṟeṉat taḷḷi yoḻukuvatu vāymiyām eṉṟaṟku nakiyiṉum poyyāmi eṉṉātu “poyyā vāymi” eṉṟāreṉa vaṟika. naki, viḷiyāṭṭu; “nakiyēyum vēṇṭaṟpāṟ ṟaṉṟu” (kuṟaḷ. 871) eṉpuḻip pōla. poyyā vāymi; poyyāmiyākiya vāymi, “poccāvāk karuvi” (kuṟaḷ. 53) eṉpuḻippōla. pakivar eññāṉṟum puṟattē kuṟṟaṅ kūṟi ikaḻvatu iyalpātaliṉ, ataṉik kēṭṭu maṉavamiti kulivatiṉum, kēḷātu avari vēroṭu tolittaṟkuriya kālamum karuviyum iṭamum nōkki yiruttal aṟivuṭi vēntaṟku āṇmiyum pukaḻum payattaliṉ, “pakivar puṟañcoṟ kēḷāp puritīr oṇmi” yeṉṟār. puritīr oṇmi yeṉṟataṉāl, pakivar puṟattē iṉimi tōṉṟak kūṟuvaṉavaṟṟiyum koḷḷāmi kūṟiyavāṟāyiṟṟu. “nalla pōlavum nayava pōlavum, tollōr ceṉṟa neṟiya pōlavum, kāta ṉeñciṉum miṭipukaṟ kalamarum, ētiṉ mākkaḷ potumoḻi koḷḷātu” (puṟam. 58) eṉṟu cāṉṟōr kūṟutal kāṇka. vāymiyum oṇmiyum muṟiyē uri yuṇarvukaṭku aṇiyāyiṉa miyiṉ, uṭaṟku aṇiyākum pūṇiṉi, “pūṇ kiḷar mārpa” eṉṟoḻintār.
iṉi, aracamātēviyiṉ nalam kūṟuvār, nāṇamē uruvāyk koṇṭu viḷaṅkum oṭpatti, “peṇmi cāṉṟu” eṉṟār. peṇmi, peṇkaṭkuriya amitittaṉmiyāyiṉum, īṇṭuc ciṟappuṭiya nāṇmēl niṉṟatu. peṇṭiriṉ uruvu nāṇattā lāya teṉpataṉi, “nāṇmeykkoṇṭīṭṭap paṭṭār” (cīvaka. 1119) eṉṟu piṉvanta cāṉṟōrum, “peṇmi taṭpa nuṇṇitiṟ ṟāṅki” (naṟ. 94) eṉap paṇṭināḷi iḷantiriya ṉārum kūṟutal kāṇka. iṉip peṇmi cāṉṟeṉṟaṟku, peṇpāṟkuriya veṉappaṭṭa (tol. po. po. 15) “ceṟi yum, niṟiyum, cemmiyum, ceppum, aṟivum, arumiyum” niṟiyappeṟṟu eṉṟumām. maṭamāvatu, tāṉ taṉ aṟikaruvi kaḷāl ārāyntu koṇṭataṉi ettuṇi iṭiyūṟum iṭiyīṭum eytiṉum viṭāmi. iḵtu aṟiviṉ tiṭpattāl viḷiyum payaṉātaliṉ “perumaṭam” eṉṟār. tāṉ taṉ vāḻkkikkut tuṇiyākak koṇṭa kātalaṟku nalantaruvaṉa vaṉṟip piṟavaṟṟiṉpāl maṭampaṭa niṟṟalpaṟṟi, maṭam eṉappaṭuva tāyiṟṟu. īttuvakkum iṉpamum pukaḻum karutuvōr piṟavaṟṟiṉ pāl maṭampaṭutalpaṟṟi, koṭimaṭam paṭutal pōlvatu itu.  itaṟku vēṟu piṟa kūṟutalumuṇṭu. kaṟpāvatu, taṉ meṉmit taṉmiyip peṟṟōrālum cāṉṟōrālum nūṉmukattālum iyaṟki yaṟivālum aṟintu, ekkālattum taṉṉip pātukāttoḻukum aṟivuṭimi. niṉivu, col, ceyal eṉṟa mūṉṟum kaṟpuneṟiyē niṟṟaliṉ, “kaṟpiṟi koṇṭa puriyōḷ” eṉṟār. iṉi, itaṟkuk kaṟpāl iṟimit taṉmipeṟṟa puriyōḷ eṉṟurippiṉu mamiyum. īṇṭuk kūṟappaṭātu eñciniṟkum naṟkuṇa naṟceykikaḷellām akappaṭa, “puriyōḷ” eṉṟār. collukku vāymiyum, niṉivukku oṇmiyumpōla uyirvāḻkkikkut tuṇimiyām iyipupaṟṟi, “puriyōḷ kaṇava” eṉpati iṭiyē kūṟiṉār.
17-19. toliyā ................ iṉpuṟuttiṉi
uri :
toliyāk koḷkic cuṟṟam cuṟṟa - kuṉṟāta kōṭpāṭṭiṉiyuṭiya cāṉṟōrākiya cuṟṟattār nīṅkātu cūḻa; vēḷviyiṉ kaṭavuḷ aruttiṉi - pōrkkaḷattē pakivari veṉṟu ceyyum kaḷavēḷviyāl veṟṟik kaṭavuṭkup paliyūṭṭi ataṉi makiḻvittāy; uyarnili yulakattu aiyar - vīrarulakattu vāḻum cāṉṟōri; kēḷvi iṉpuṟuttiṉi - avar ceyta vīracceyalkaḷip pulavar pāṭa iruntu kēṭkumāṟṟāl makiḻvittāy eṉṟavāṟu.
uyirkkiṟuti vantaviṭattum aṟattiṟ ṟiriyāk kōṭ pāṭṭi yuṭiyarāy vēntaṟku meynniḻalpōlap piṉ ceṉṟu uṟutiyāvaṉa āṟṟum uḷḷamuṭiyarātaliṉ, “toli yāk koḷkic cuṟṟam” eṉṟār. tammāṟ cuṟṟappaṭṭa talivaṉ celvam vali mutaliyaṉa tolin tavaḻiyum, avaṉi nīṅkātu paḻimi pārāṭṭum paṇpiṉarātal paṟṟit toliyāk koḷkic cuṟṟattār eṉac ciṟappit tāreṉa vaṟika. “paṟṟaṟṟa kaṇṇum paḻimi pārāṭṭutal cuṟṟattār kaṇṇē yuḷa” (kuṟaḷ. 521) eṉṟu āciriyar kūṟutal kāṇka. vel pōraṇṇa lātaliṉ, veṟṟi yeytun tōṟum kaḷavēḷvi ceytu kaṭavuḷari makiḻvikkiṉṟā ṉeṉṟaṟku “vēḷviyiṟ kaṭavuḷ aruttiṉi” eṉṟār. “aracupaṭa vamaruḻakki, muracu koṇṭu kaḷam vēṭṭa, aṭutiṟa luyarpukaḻ vēntē” (maturik. 128-30) eṉṟu cāṉṟōr kūṟutal kāṇka. iṉi, vēḷviyeṉap potuppaṭak kūṟiṉamiyiṉ, pārppār vēṭkum vēḷvikkum tuṇipurintu vēṭpikku mutalvaṉāyk kaṭavuḷari iṉpuṟut tiṉi yeṉpārumuḷar.
kēḷvi yeṉpuḻi, ētupporuṭṭāya iṉṉurupu vikārattāṟ ṟokkatu. aṟappōr purintu uyir tuṟantōr vīraruṟiyum tuṟakkam pukuvarātaliṉ, avarkaḷi “uyarnili yulakat tiyar” eṉṟār. avaruṭiya oḻukalāṟṟiyum pōrttiṟaṉiyum pulavar pāṭa, pāṇar icikka, kūttar kūttiyaṟṟak kaṇṭum kēṭṭum ciṟappittalāl avar iṉpuṟuvar eṉṟa karuttāl, “kēḷviyiṉ uyarnili yulakattiyar iṉpuṟut tiṉi” yeṉṟār. ikkoḷki pattām nūṟṟāṇṭilum iruntu vantatu eṉṟaṟkut tiruttakkattēvar eḻutiya cīvaka cintāmaṇi cāṉṟu pakarkiṉṟatu. iṉi, īṇṭuk kūṟiya aiyari muṉivarākki, avaruritta maṟikaḷi yōtuvatu avarkku iṉpam ceyyumeṉṟu koṇṭu, itu kūṟiṉāreṉpāru muḷar.
20-22. vaṇaṅkiya ............ aṇṇal
uri :
vaṇaṅkiya cāyal - naṭpaminta cāṉṟōrkkup paṇin toḻukum meṉmiyiṉiyum; vaṇaṅkā āṇmi - pakivarkku vaṇaṅkāta āṇmiyiṉiyumuṭiya; iḷan tuṇip putalvariṉ - iḷantuṇiyākiya makkaḷikkoṇṭu; mutiyarppēṇi - mutiyarākiya periyōrkkuriya toṇṭiṉic ceyvittu; tol kaṭaṉ iṟutta - toṉṟutoṭṭa tam kaṭamiyiṉi āṟṟiya; velpōr aṇṇal - vellukiṉṟa pōriyuṭiya aṇṇalē eṉṟavāṟu.
tām piṟanta kuṭiyiṉ nalattip pēṇum naṇpaminta cāṉṟōrkku aṭaṅkiyoḻukum nallāṟṟiṉi “vaṇaṅkiya cāyal” eṉṟār. aṭaṅki yoḻukumiṭattu meṉmip paṇpallatu piṟitoṉṟum tōṉṟāmiyiṉ “cāyal” eṉṟum, vaṇakkamilvaḻi, mutiyōrāl tam tolkuṭivaravum tollōr mēṟkoṇṭu ciṟanta toṉṉeṟimāṇpum uṇarttap paṭāvākaliṉ “vaṇaṅkiya” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. iṉiyārpāl tōṉṟum aṭakkam ciṟappātal paṟṟi, ataṉi mutaṟkaṇvit tōtiṉār. iḷamiyilē māṉattiṉ nīṅkā āṇmi naṟkuṭip piṟantōrkkuk karuvilē vāytta tiruvātal tōṉṟa “vaṇaṅkā āṇmi” yeṉṟār. vaṇaṅkāmik kētuvākiya āṇmi “vaṇaṅkā āṇmi” yeṉappaṭṭatu. āṭavar piṟa tuṟikku vēṇṭappaṭutaliṉ, mutiyarppēṇum nallaṟatti “iḷantuṇip putalvariṉ” āṟṟiṉāṉ eṉṟār. mutiyōr, mutumi yeytumuṉ nāṭu kāttaṟku “aṟivu vēṇṭiyavaḻi aṟivu utaviyum vāḷ vēṇṭuvaḻi vāḷutaviyum” (puṟam. 179) tuṇipurintōr. avari mutumikkaṇ pēṇutal naṉṟiyaṟita lākiya pēraṟa mākaliṉ, “mutiyarp pēṇit tolkaṭaṉ iṟutta aṇṇal” eṉṟār. iṉi, mutiyō reṉṟatu pitirarka ḷeṉṟum, avarkku, ilvāḻvār  ceytaṟkuriya kaṭaṉ, makkaḷippeṟutal eṉṟum koṇṭu, iḷantuṇip putalvarppēṟṟāl mutiya rākiya pitirarkkuriya tolkaṭaṉi iṟuttā yeṉṟum kūṟupa, vēṟu cilar tāymāmaṉ mutalāyiṉārkkuc ceyyuṅ kaṭaṉ tolkaṭaṉeṉṟum tantiyarkkuc ceyyuṅ kaṭaṉ pitirkkaṭaṉeṉṟum kūṟuvar. mutumiyuṟṟa cāṉṟōrkkum muṉivararkkum tām peṟṟa iḷantuṇi makkaḷit toṇṭu ceyya viṭuttavākiya ceyal vaṭanāṭṭiṉum nilaviṟṟeṉpa taṟku irāmāyaṇamum pāratamum cāṉṟu pakarkiṉṟaṉa. makappēṟṟāl pitirkkaṭaṉ kaḻiyu meṉṉum vaṭavarkoḷki, tamiḻnāṭṭavarkku illi. tiruvaḷḷuvar, makappēṟu pitirk kaṭaṉiṟukkum vāyileṉak kūṟāmiyē itaṟkuc cāṉṟa kariyām. tollōrkkum iṟuttaṟkuriya kaṭaṉātaliṉ, tolkaṭaṉ eṉappaṭṭatu. ikkālattum tamiḻmakkaḷiṭiyē mutiyōr, iḷiyōr maṇampuṇarntu tampāl vāḻttup peṟuvāṉ aṭivīḻntu vaṇaṅkuṅkāl, “viriya makkaḷip peṟṟut taruka; am makkaḷ kiyāl taṇṇī raruntiṉāl eṅkaḷ uyir cāntipeṟum” eṉṟu vāḻttum vaḻakka muṇmi ikkarutti valiyuṟuttum. iv vaḻakkuc cēra vēntarpālum iruntateṉṟaṟku. “kaṭalpiṟak kōṭṭiya ceṅkuṭṭuvaṉik kācaṟu ceyyuṭ pāṭiya paraṇarkku, avaṉtaṉ makaṉ kuṭṭuvaṉ cēralik koṭutta ceytiyi ip patiṟṟuppattiṉ aintām patikam kūṟuvatu pōtiya cāṉṟākum.
iṉi, vaṇaṅkiya cāyaliyum vaṇaṅkā āṇmiyiṉiyum cēramāṉukkē ēṟṟi velpōr aṇṇaleṉpataṉōṭu muṭippāru muḷar.
23-27. māṭōr ........... nāḷē
uri :
māṭōr uṟiyum ulakamum kēṭpa - tēvarkaḷ vāḻum poṉṉulakattum kēṭkumpaṭi; iḻum eṉa iḻitarum paṟikkura laruvi - iḻumeṉṉu maṉukaraṇamuṇṭāka vīḻum paṟipōṉṟa muḻakkattiyuṭiya aruvikaḷ; muḻumutal miciya kōṭu toṟum tuvaṉṟum - mikap periyavākiya ucciyiṉiyuṭiya muṭikaḷtōṟum niṟintu viḷaṅkum; ayiri neṭuvaripōla - ayiri eṉṉum neṭiya maliyip pōla; nī vāḻum nāḷ toliyātāka - nī vāḻum vāḻnāḷ kuṟiyātu perukumāka eṉṟavāṟu.
māṭu, poṉ; avvulakiṉiyuṭiya tēvari “māṭōr” eṉṟār. maṇṇulakattēyaṉṟip poṉṉulakattavarum kēṭkumāṟu muḻaṅkukiṉṟa teṉṟaṟku, “ulakamum kēṭpa” eṉṟār. aruviyiṉ nīroḻukku iḻumeṉum aṉukaraṇa vōciyum, kīḻē vīḻntavaḻip paṟipōṉṟa muḻakka muṭimiyiṉ, “iḻumeṉa viḻitarum paṟikkura laruvi” yeṉṟār; “iḻumeṉa iḻitarum aruvi” (muruku. 316) eṉṟum, “paṟiyici yaruvi” (puṟam. 125) eṉṟum cāṉṟōr kūṟutal kāṇka. ic ciṟappuppaṟṟi, itaṟkup paṟikkura laruvi yeṉṟu peyarāyiṟṟeṉa vaṟika. ayiri, mēṟkumalit toṭariluḷḷa toru mali; itiṟ piṟakkum ayiriyāṟu mēlikkaṭalil viḻukiṟatu. aruvi tuvaṉṟum ayiri neṭuvari toliyātu nilipeṟuvatu pōla nī vāḻum nāḷ toliyātāka eṉa vāḻttiyavāṟu; ivvāṟē piṟarum, “kaṭavuḷ ayiriyiṉ niliik, kēṭila vāka peruma niṉpukaḻē” (patiṟ. 79) eṉṟu vāḻttutal kāṇka.
itukāṟum kūṟiyatu: “vayavar peruma, puriyōḷ kaṇava, pūṇkiḷar mārpa, velpō raṇṇal, vēḷviyiṟ kaṭavuḷ aruttiṉi; kēḷviyiṉ uyarnili yulakattu aiyar iṉpuṟut tiṉi; ātaliṉ kōṭutoṟum aruvi tuvaṉṟum neṭuvari pōla, nī vāḻum nāḷ toliyā tāka” eṉa viṉimuṭivu ceyka.
“itaṉāṟ colliyatu, avaṉ veṉṟi kūṟiya tiṟattāṉē avaṟkuḷḷa ciṟappukkaḷik kūṟip piṉṉi vāḻttiya vāṟāyiṟṟu.”
ēḻām pattu  mūlamum uriyum muṟṟum.

1-8. aṟāa .......... uṭaṟṟiyōrē
uri :
aṟāa yāṇar akaṉkaṇ ceṟuviṉ - nīṅkāta putu varuvāyiṉiyuṭiya akaṉṟa iṭam poruntiya vayaliṭattē; aruvi āmpal neytaloṭu arintu - niṟinta pūkkaḷākiya āmpaliyum neytaliyum nelluṭaṉē aṟuttu; ceṟu viṉimakaḷir - tokuppatākiya aṟuvaṭittoḻil ceyyum uḻavar makaḷir; melinta vekki - neruṅkiyuḷḷa neṟkaḷattiṉ kaṇ; parūup pakaṭu utirtta - parutta erumikaḷ kaṭāviṭap paṭutalāl mitittutirtta; meṉ cennelliṉ - melliya cennelliṉkaṇ; ampaṇa vaḷavi uṟi kuvittāṅku - marakkālkaḷi aḷattaṟkāka neṟkuviyil ceruki vittatu pōla; kaṭun tēṟu uṟukiḷi;  - kaḻatākak koṭṭi varuttum mikutiyāṉa kuḷavikaḷ; mocintaṉa tuñcum ceḻuṅkūṭu - tammil neruṅkik kūṭiyiruntu uṟaṅkum ceḻumiyāṉa kūṭṭiṉi; kiḷitta - kalitta; iḷantuṇi makāariṉ - iḷañciṟārkaḷ pōla; peruma - perumāṉē; niṉ uṭaṟṟi yōr - niṉṉoṭu porak karuti māṟupaṭṭōr; alantaṉar - alamantu varuntaluṟṟaṉar eṉṟavāṟu.
kuḷaviyiṉam tammiṟ kūṭit tokkiyirukkum kūṭu, neṟ kuvikkum - kuḷavi, uṟi kuvittukkiṭanta ampaṇavaḷavik kum - ak kūṭṭik kalittuviṭṭa iḷantuṇic ciṟārkaḷ, avi koṭṭu meṉṟu añci mūlikkoruvarāyc citaṟi yōṭutal, cēramāṉip pakittup porutavar keṭṭu alamarutaṟkum - uvamamāyiṉa,
yāṇar, putumi; īṇṭup putuvaruvāy mēṟṟu. ār vī eṉaṟpālatu aru vi yeṉa niṉṟatu; ārtal, niṟital. ārnteṉpatu arunteṉa niṟpatu (kali. 22) pōla, ār vī aru vī yeṉat tirintu piṉ aruvi yeṉak kuṟukiṟṟu. aruvi yāmpal eṉpataṟkup paḻiya vurikārar, nīriṉ āmpal eṉṟu poruḷ kūṟi, “eṉṟataṉāṟ payaṉ nīrkkuṟivaṟṟa āmpal eṉpatām” eṉṟum, “eṇṇiṉ āmpali nīkkutaṟ keṉpatu moṉṟu” eṉṟum kūṟuvar. oṭu, eṇṇoṭu. arinteṉavē, nelluṭaṉē arital peṟṟām. arinta neṟcūṭṭik kaḷattē cērttuk kaṭāviṭṭut tūṟṟi neṟpayaṉ peṟupavātaliṉ, “parūuppaka ṭutirtta meṉcennel” eṉṟār. vekki, neṟkaḷam. arintu malinta vekki yeṉa muṭikka. ceṟuviṉi makaḷir eṉpuḻi, nellarintu tokuttalākiya viṉi īṇṭuc ceṟuviṉi yeṉappaṭṭatu. makaḷir arintu malintirukkumiṭam vekki yātalpaṟṟi, malinta vekki yeṉṟār.  paḻiyavuri kārar, “arintu pakaṭutirtta eṉak kūṭṭip pakaṭṭāṉeṉa urupu virikka” eṉpar. ceṟivaḷi makaḷir eṉṟu pāṭaṅ koṇṭu, “uḻavar peṇmakkaḷ viḷiyāṭutaṟku vayaliṟ payir koḷḷātō riṭamiṉmiyiṉ āṇṭu avarkaḷ mikka kaḷam, ceṟivaḷi makaḷir malinta vekkiyāyiṟ” ṟeṉpar. ceṟuviṉi makaḷi reṉṟē koṇṭu, makaḷiri viḷiyāṭṭu makaḷirākak koḷḷiṉ, viṉiyiṉi ākupeyarāl viṉipuriyum uḻavarkkēṟṟuka.
pakaṭu koṇṭu kaṭāviṭṭut teḻittum paṇṭiyi lēṟṟip pakaṭṭiṉāl koṇarvittum neṟpayaṉ koḷḷap peṟutaliṉ, “pakaṭutirtta meṉcennel” eṉap pakaṭṭāl vicēṭittār; piṟarum “pakaṭutaru cennel” (puṟam. 390) eṉṟal kāṇka. cennel, veṇṇel pōlum nelvaki. meṉmi “cōṟṟatu meṉmi” yeṉpatu paḻiyavuri.
tūymi ceyta cennellip poṉmalipōṟ kuvittu, ataṉi aḷattaṟkeṉṟu ampaṇa vaḷaviyic ceruki vittiruppatu, kūṭṭiṭattē kuḷaviyiṉam iruppatu pōṟaliṉ, “aḷavi niṟikuvittāṅku” eṉṟār. aḷaviyi neṟ kuviyil uṟivittalāvatu, ataṉ uṭpuṟattē oru pakuti nelliruppap putittal. uṟi vittal, kuc cāriyi peṟṟu uṟikuvittal eṉa vantatu. aḷavi: toḻiṟpeyar; nāṉkāvatu vikārattāl tokkatu. itaṉi iṟṟip pōtum neṟ kaḷaṅkaḷilum nel viṟkum kaḷarikaḷilum kāṇalām. paṇṭināḷiya ampaṇam mūṅkilālāyatu; iṟṟi nāḷiya ampaṇam, irumpiṉālāyatu; ituvē vēṟupāṭu. tēṟu, koṭṭum kuḷavi; tāṉ kuṟitta poruḷik koṭukkiṉāl teṟuvatu paṟṟit tēṟu eṉap peyar peṟṟatu. koṭṭiyavaḻi yuṇṭākum tuṉpa mikutipaṟṟi, kaṭuntēṟu eṉṟār. atu vāḻum kūṭṭi yaḻikkiṉ, aḻippāric cūḻntuteṟum iyalpiṟṟātal paṟṟi, mutiyōr atu ceyyārātaliṉ, kūṭṭi yaḻippavar iḷañciṟār eṉpatu koṇṭu, “ceḻuṅ kūṭu kiḷitta iḷantuṇi makāar” eṉṟār. mocital, niṟital. makāar, iḷiyōr mēṟṟu; “ciṟutoḻil makāar” (akam. 206) eṉpuḻip pōla. ceḻuṅkūṭu kiḷitta makār, kuḷaviyiṉ kaṭunteṟaṟkañci yalantu mūlikkoruvarāy ōṭi yulamaruvatu pōla, “niṉ uṭaṟṟiyōr alantaṉar” eṉṟār. 
kaṭuntēṟ ṟuṟukiḷi, makāarpāl paki niṉiyātu taṉ ceḻuṅ kūṭṭiṉkaṇ uṟukiḷiyuṭaṉ tuñcum eṉṟataṉāl, nīyum niṉ ceḻumaṉikkaṇ kiḷiyuṭaṉ iṉitirukkiṉṟaṉiyē yaṉṟip piṟarip pakikkiṉṟā yilliyāyiṉum, makār tam iḷamiyāl kūṭu kiḷittu varuntuvatupōla, niṉ uṭaṟṟi yōr tam aṟiyāmiyāl pōr viḷittuk keṭuvārāyiṉar eṉṟaliṉ, “alantaṉar niṉ uṭaṟṟiyōr” eṉṟum, “peruma” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. iṉip paḻiyavurikārar, “aḷavikkeṉa nāṉkāvatu virikka” eṉṟum, “kaṭuntēṟuṟukiḷi, kaṭitākat teṟutaliyuṭiya mikka kuḷaviyiṉam” eṉṟum, “mocintaṉa veṉṟatu, moyttaṉavāy eṉṉum viṉiyeccamuṟ” ṟeṉṟum kūṟuvar.
neṟkuviyum ampaṇavaḷaviyum kuḷaviyiṉattiṉ ceḻuṅ kūṭṭiyum kuḷaviyiyum ciṟappikkum uvamamāyiṉa: ivi uruvuvamam. kuḷaviyum, ataṉ kūṭum, akkūṭu kiḷikkum iḷantuṇi makāarum eṉṟa mūṉṟuvamikaḷum cēramāṉi yum avaṉ nakariyum pakivariyum cuṭṭit toḻiluvama māyiṉa. ākavē ivi aṭuttuvara luvama mākāmi yaṟika. iṉi, uṟi kuvittal, eṉpataṉi irucoṟpaṭap pirittu, uṟiyākak kuvittal eṉṟu koṇṭu aḷaviyiṉ uṟiyiṭṭa vāyiṭattē kuvikkappaṭuvatupōla nilattē kuvittuvittal eṉṟu urittalumoṉṟu. atu poruḷāyiṉ, uṟiyākak kuvitta nelliṉic ceḻuṅ kūṭṭiṟku uvamamākak koḷka.
itaṉāṟ kūṟiyatu: makaḷir malinta vekkikkaṇ tokutta nelliṉiṭattē ampaṇa vaḷavi uṟikuvit tāṅku, kaṭuntēṟ ṟuṟukiḷi tuñcum kūṭu kiḷitta makāariṉ, niṉ uṭaṟṟi yōr alantaṉar eṉak kūṭṭi viṉimuṭivu ceyka.
9-13. ūreri ......... vuviṉi
uri :
pōr cuṭu eri ūr kavara - pōriṉkaṇṇē cuṭutaṟkāka eṭutta tīyāṉatu pakivar ūrkaḷik kavarntuṇṭalāl; kamaḻ puki - cuṭunāṟṟam nāṟukiṉṟa puki; urutteḻuntu urii - mikkeḻuntu parantu; mātiram maṟippa - ticikaḷi maṟikka; tōṉṟal īyātu - veḷit tōṉṟāmal; matilvāy - matiṟkuḷḷē yiruntu; tam paḻi ūkkunar - tam kuṟṟattāl paḻi ceytu koḷḷum pakivaruṭiya; kuṇṭukaṇ akaḻiya - āḻnta iṭattiyuṭiya akaḻiyiṉiyum; kuṟuntāḷ ñāyil - kuṟukiya paṭikaḷiyuṭiya ñāyiliyumuṭiya; ār eyil tōṭṭi vuviṉi - kaṭattaṟkariya matiṟkāvali yaḻittuk kavarntu koṇṭaṉi, yātalāl eṉṟavāṟu.
pōruṭaṟṟuvōr pakippulattē tī vittal muṟi yākaliṉ, pōr cuṭu eri eṉṟār. itaṉi eriparanteṭutta leṉṟum uḻapula vañci yeṉṟum āciriyaṉmār kūṟupa. ūr muḻutum eri paravuvatāl puki mikkeḻuntu emmaruṅkum cūḻntukoḷḷum tiṟatti, “urutteḻunturiip pōrcuṭu kamaḻpuki mātiram maṟippa” eṉṟār. iṉi, “eri urutteḻun turii ūr kavara” eṉṟu iyippiṉu mamiyum. paḻiya vurikārarum, “urutteḻun turii ūr eri kavara eṉak kūṭṭuka” eṉṟal kāṇka. pakivar ūriṭattē nī eṭutta tīyāṉatu avvūrkaḷik kavarntuṇṇa, ataṉāl eḻunta perumpuki mātiram maṟikka, nī appakivaruṭiya eyili vuviṉi yeṉpār, “āreyil tōṭṭi vuviṉi” yeṉṟār; “nīyuṭaṉṟōr maṉṉeyil tōṭṭi viyā” (patiṟ. 25) eṉṟu piṟarum kūṟutal kāṇka.
pakivar, puṟamatilic cūḻntukoṇṭavaḻi, añcātu veḷippōntu avarip porutaḻittu vēṟalō, ap pōriṭippaṭṭu vīḻtalō iraṇṭi loṉṟic ceyyātu akamatiṟkaṇ aṭipaṭṭu maṭintiruttalāl perumpaḻiyē viḷiyumātaliṉ, “matilvāyt tōṉṟa līyātu tampaḻi yūkkunar” eṉṟār. tōṉṟa līyā teṉpatu tōṉṟāma leṉṉum poruṭṭu. paḻiyavurikārarum “tōṉṟa līyā teṉṟatu, tōṉṟā teṉṉum viṉiyeccat tiricol” eṉṟum, “tōṉṟa līyāmaleṉat tirikka” eṉṟum kūṟuvar.
ñāyil, matiliṉ akattē puṟattōr aṟiyāvaki yiruntu ampu toṭukkum mukkōṇa vaṟi. itaṉi ēppuḻi ñāyi leṉpar. matiṟṟaliyil mēliṭattē ciṟuciṟu paṭikaḷi yuṭittā yiruttalpaṟṟi, itaṉik “kuṟuntāḷ ñāyil” eṉṟār. viṟpoṟi yiruntu entirattāl ampu coriya ataṟku iṭaṉākiya ñāyilit tāḷuṭiyatu pōlak kūṟum ciṟappup paṟṟi, kuṟuntāḷ ñāyi leṉṟu ip pāṭṭiṟkup peyarāyiṟṟu. “kuṟuntāḷ ñāyileṉṟatu, iṭiyiṭiyē matiliṉ aṭiyiṭaṅkaḷip pārkka avaṟṟiṟ kuṟukikkuṟuki yirukkum paṭiyiyuṭiya ñāyileṉṟavāṟu” eṉṟum, “ivvāṟu kūṟiya cātippaṇpāṉum, paṭiyit tāḷeṉṟu kūṟiyaṉapaṭiyāṉum itaṟkuk kuṟuntāṇ ñāyil eṉṟu peyarāyiṟ” ṟeṉṟum, “vuviṉi yeṉṟatu viṉi yeccamuṟ” ṟeṉṟum paḻiyavurikārar kūṟuvar.
13-24. ēṟoṭu .......... ūḻi
uri :
āṉpayam vāḻnar - āṉpayaṉ koṇṭu vāḻum iṭiyar kaḷ; ēṟoṭu kaṉṟuṭi āyam tarīi - ēṟukaḷuṭaṉ kaṉṟukaḷi yuṭiya āṉirikaḷik koṇarntu tarutalāl; pulavuvil iḷiyar - pulāl nāṟum villēntiya veṭciyārākiya niṉ vīrar; pukal ciṟantu - avarpāl viruppam mikku; aṅki viṭuppa - tām kippaṟṟiya āṉirikaḷiyum viṭṭoḻiya; mattuk kayiṟu āṭā vikaṟpoḻutu - tayirkaṭiyum mattiṉiṭattē kayiṟāṭāta viṭiyaṟpōtiṉkaṇ; niṉiyūu - niṉṉip puka laṭiya niṉintu pōntu; kaḻuvuḷ tali maṭaṅka - kaḻuvu ḷeṉṉum iṭiyartalivaṉ talivaṇaṅki niṉṟataṉāl; pati pāḻāka vēṟu pulam paṭarntu - ūrkaḷ palavum pāḻpaṭum paṭiyākap pakivar nāṭu nōkkic ceṉṟu; viruntiṉ vāḻkkiyoṭu - putu varuvāykoṇṭu iṉitu vāḻtaṟkētuvākiya celvattōṭu; perun tiru aṟṟeṉa - tam muṉṉōr īṭṭi vitta peruñ celvamum iṉik keṭṭa teṉṟeṇṇi; aruñcamattu arunili tāṅkiya - kaṭattaṟkariya pōriṉkaṇ taṭuttaṟkariya pōrniliyit taṭuttuc ciṟanta; pukar nutal peruṅ kaḷiṟṟu yāṉiyoṭu - puḷḷi poruntiya neṟṟiyiṉiyuṭiya periya kaḷiṟṟiyāṉi kaḷiyum; aruṅkalam tarāar - ariya aṇikalaṉkaḷiyum tiṟiyākac celuttāta pakivēntar; mey paṉi kūrā - uṭalnaṭukkam mikuntu; aṇaṅkeṉap parāvaliṉ- varuttak kūṭiya teyvameṉa niṉṉi niṉintu paravuvatāl, pali koṇṭu peyarum pācampōla - taṉṉāl tākkuṇṭār uyirik koḷḷātu avar iṭṭa paliyiṉik koṇṭu nīṅkum pēy pōla; tiṟikoṇṭu peyarti - avar iṭum tiṟikaḷik koṇṭu avar, uyiri yaḷittuviṭṭut tirumpi ēkukiṉṟāy; niṉ ūḻi vāḻka - niṉakkut teyvattāl variyaṟukkappaṭṭa vāḻnāḷ muḻutum iṉitu vāḻvāyāka eṉṟavāṟu.
kaḻuvuḷ eṉpavaṉ, āyar talivaṉāy ēṉi vēntaruṭaṉ perum paki koṇṭiruntavaṉ; ataṉāl avaṉip piṟarum, “poru muraṇeytiya kaḻuvuḷ” (patiṟ. 88) eṉṟal kāṇka. avaṉirunta nakari muṟṟi, avaṉuṭiya āreyil tōṭṭiyi nī vuvikkoṇṭamiyiṉ, avaṉ aṭimatiṟpaṭṭuk kiṭappa, avaṉ kīḻ vāḻnta iṭiyarkaḷ vēṟu pukalkāṇātu tammuṭiya āṉirikaḷit tāmē koṇarntu tantu aruḷ vēṇṭi niṉṟami tōṉṟa, “āṉpayam vāḻnar ēṟoṭu kaṉṟuṭi āyam tarīi” eṉṟār. āṉiriyāṉ varum pāṟpayaṉ koṇṭu uyirvāḻum iyalpiṉarāyiṉum, avaṟṟit tantēṉum niṉ aruṇiḻal vāḻvu peṟutal vēṇṭumeṉa niṉintaṉa reṉpār, “āṉpayam vāḻnar” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. tam uyirkoṭuttu aruḷvēṇṭiṉar eṉpatu karuttu. atukaṇṭa niṉ vīrar tām muṉpē pōntu veṭci neṟiyiṟ kippaṟṟiya avar tam āṉirikaḷi aruḷāl vaḻaṅkiṉamiyiṉ, “pukal ciṟantu aṅki viṭuppa” eṉṟār. pakivar tām uyirvāḻtaṟ kētuvāyavaṟṟit tāmē tantu puṟaṅkāṭṭu taliṉum cīriya veṟṟiyiṉmiyiṉ, “pukal ciṟan” teṉṟār. iv vāyar mutaṟkaṇ tām āḷum āṇmiyum uḷḷaḷavum porutuniṉṟami tōṉṟa, villēntiya vīrar ciṟappi, “pulavu vil liḷiyar” eṉṟār. peruntiraḷāṉa makkaḷik koṉṟata ṉāl villēnti ampu toṭukkum kikaḷ, kuruti tōyntu pulavu nāṟutal orutali. ampu toṭuttu āyarkaḷik kollātu aruḷ ceyyum ciṟappu nōkki, “aṅki” yeṉṟār. pakittup porutār mēl kaṇṇōṭātu ampu celuttum neṟikku iḷami mēmpaṭṭu niṟpiṉum, aḵtu aruḷuṭimiyāl cāl puṟṟiruntami viḷaṅka, “iḷiyar” eṉṟār.
taṉ vīrarākiya āyarkaḷ poruvatu viṭṭu āṉiri kaḷit tantu niṉ aruḷ vāḻvu vēṇṭiyataṟinta kaḻuvuḷ, tāṉ avarkaṭkut talivaṉākiyum talimip paṇiyiṉi yāṟṟum valiyiṉmiyāl nāṇip pakaṟpōtiṟ pōntu pukalaṭiyātu vikaṟikkaṇ varutali niṉintā ṉeṉpār, “mattuk kayiṟāṭā vikaṟ poḻutu niṉiyūu” eṉṟār. vikaṟip pōtil āymakaḷ eḻuntu tayir kaṭintukoṇṭu, ñāyiṟṟiṉ veyil mikumuṉ māṟi varavēṇṭi yiruttaliṉ, vikaṟi yāmattiṉ iṟutikkālatti “mattukkayi ṟāṭā vikaṟ poḻutu” eṉṟār. ak kālattē iyaṅkuvōr uruvam ōraḷavu iṉitu teriyum. pakaṟpōtu varaṟku nāṇamum, iruṭpōtu variṉ kāvalar kolvareṉṉum accamum varuttutalāl, vikaṟippoḻutu koḷḷappaṭṭatu. niṉivu piṟantavaḻi, ceyki payaṉātalpaṟṟi, “niṉiyūu” eṉṟār. kaḻuvuḷ eṉpāṉ taṉ perumuraṇaḻintu māṉattāl tali vaṇaṅkiniṟpatu vīramākāmiyiṉ, “tali maṭaṅka” eṉṟār. vaṇaṅkiyatu kaṇṭa tuṇiyē, avaṉpāṟkoṇṭa pakimi niṉṉuḷḷatti ṉiṉṟum, nīṅkutaliṉ, vēṟu pulam niṉintu celkuviyāyiṉi eṉpār. “vēṟu pulam paṭarntu” eṉṟum, accelavāl pakivar ūrkaḷ aḻivatu orutali yātaliṉ, “pati pāḻāka” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. paṭarntu tiṟikoṇṭu peyarti eṉa viṉimuṭivu ceyka.
“vuviṉi yeṉṟatu, viṉiyeccamuṟṟu. āyam tarīi yeṉṟatu āyaṅkaḷi nī pulavuvil iḷiyarkkuk koṭuppa eṉṟavāṟu. tarīi yeṉpataṉit tara veṉat tirikka. iḷiyar aṅki viṭuppa eṉṟatu, iḷiyar av vāyattit taṅkaḷ aṅkiyiṉiṉṟum piṟarkku viṭuppa eṉṟavāṟu. kayiṟāṭā veṉṉum peyarecca maṟiyi vikaleṉṉum toḻiṟ peyaroṭu muṭikka. vikal - kaḻital. vikaṟpoḻutu: iru peyaroṭṭu. vāḻnar - vāḻpavar, iṭiyar. payattāṉeṉa virikka. kaḻuvuḷāvāṉ, avviṭiyarkkut talivaṉāy akkālattuk kuṟumpu ceytiruntā ṉoruvaṉ. muṉṉar eyileṉṟatu, avaṉ taṉakku araṇākak koṇṭirunta matiliṉi. vēṟu pulam pati pāḻākap paṭarnteṉṟatu, ak kaḻuvuḷ talimaṭaṅkukiyālē avaṉi viṭṭu, vēṟu tiṟiyiṭāk kuṟumpar nāṭṭilē annāṭṭup pati pāḻākac ceṉṟu eṉṟavāṟu. “paṭarntu tiṟikoṇṭu peyarti yeṉak kūṭṭuka” eṉṟu paḻiyavurikārar kūṟuvar.
iṉi, pakivar kaḷiṟum kalaṉum tiṟiyākat tārā toḻintataṟ kētuvākiya avaruṭiya peruñcelva niliyi, “viruntiṉ vāḻkkiyoṭu peruntiru” eṉṟār. viruntu, īṇṭup putitāka īṭṭap peṟum celvattiṉ mēṟṟu; ac celvattiṉ payaṉ iṉpa vāḻkki yeṉpa. “perun tiru, muṉṉōr īṭṭivittuc ceṉṟa peruñ celvam: “peruñ celvam” (kuṟaḷ. 1000) eṉpataṟkup parimēlaḻakarum ivvāṟu kūṟutal kāṇka. iṉip paḻiyavurikārar, viruntiṉ vāḻkki yāvatu” “nāṭōṟum putitākat tāṅkaḷ tēṭukiṉṟa poruḷ” eṉṟum, “perun tiru, muṉṉē tēṭik kiṭanta poruḷ” eṉṟum kūṟuvar.
pati pāḻāka vēṟu pulamākiya tam nāṭu nōkki nī varuvatu kaṇṭa niṉ pakivartam vāḻkkiyum tiruvum aḻintaṉa veṉṟu karuti uḷamum uṭalum oruṅku naṭuṅkiṉa reṉpār, “viruntiṉ vāḻkkiyoṭu peruntiru aṟṟeṉa meypaṉi kūrā” eṉṟār. paḻiyavurikārar “aṟṟeṉa veṉṟatu, aṟṟateṉak karuti yeṉṟavāṟu” eṉṟum, “aṟṟa teṉpatu kaṭik kuṟinta” teṉṟum kūṟuvar.
aruñ camattu arunili yeṉṟatu, kaṭumpōr nikaḻu miṭattu vellutal ariteṉṉumāṟu irutiṟattu vīrarum maṇṭip porum nilimiyākum. an nilimikkaṇ añcātu niṉṟa pakivar muṉṉēṟāvāṟu takintu vellum pōrttakuti peṟṟa kaḷiṟu eṉṟaṟku, ivvāṟu ciṟappittār eṉa aṟika. tiṟiceluttum vēntar ittakiya kaḷiṟukaḷiyum uyariya aṇikalaṉkaḷiyum taruvareṉpataṉi, “oḷiṟuvāḷ vayavēntar, kaḷiṟoṭu kalantantu, toṉṟu moḻintu toḻil kēṭpa” (patiṟ. 90) eṉṟu piṟarum kūṟumāṟṟāṉaṟika. aruṅkalan tārāta pakiva reṉṉātu “tarāar” eṉat toḻilmēl vittōtiyatu, tārāmik kētuvāya pakimi nīṅkit tarutaṟ kētuvākiya accamuṇmi pulappaṭuttaṟku. pakivar tam muṭiya āṇmi, aṟivu, poruḷ, paṭi mutaliya vali vakiyik kaṭantu mēmpaṭṭu niṟṟalpaṟṟi niṉṉit tākki varuttum aṇaṅkeṉak karutiṉā reṉṟum, aṇaṅkoṭu porutu vēṟal makkaṭ karitātaliṉ, avar ceyaṟpālatu vaḻipāṭu oṉṟēyaṉṟip piṟitilli yātaliṉ “parāvaliṉ” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār.
“palikoṇṭu peyarum pācam” eṉavē uyir koḷḷātu viṭuttēkuvatu peṟṟām. pācam, pēy. pēyi uvamaṅ kūṟiyatu pōla, tiruttakka tēvarum cīvakaṉi, “peṇṇalaṅ kātaliṟ pēyumāyiṉāṉ” (cīvaka. 2010) eṉṟu kūṟutal kāṇka.
25-27. uravarum ........... vāḻumōrē
uri :
uravarum maṭavarum aṟivu terin teṇṇi - aṟivuṭi yōr aṟivunalattiyum maṭavōratu aṟiyāmiyiṉiyum ārāyntu ceyvatum tavirvatum niṉintu; aṟintaṉi aruḷāyāyiṉ - avaravar takutiyaṟintu aruḷā toḻikuvi yāyiṉ; neṭuntaki - neṭiya takuti yuṭiyōṉē; ivaṇ vāḻumōr yār - ivvulakil vāḻvōr ilarāvar eṉṟavāṟu.
aṟivu terinteṉavē, aṟiyāmiyum terintavāṟu peṟappaṭutaliṉ, ataṉiyum peytu koṇṭu irutiṟat tārkku muṟiyē kūṭṭi uri kūṟappaṭṭatu. uram, aṟiviṉ tiṇmi. uravōr aṟivunalam tērntu avarit taḻīik kōṭal vēntarkkuk kaṭaṉātalālum, maṭavōr ciṟṟiṉat tā rātaliṉ, avarōṭu cērāmi vēṇṭutalālum, irutiṟat tārkkum ceyvatum tavirvatum aṟiyavēṇṭuvaṉavāyiṉa. uravōr puriyum aṟivuṭicceyalkaṇṭu aruḷalum, maṭavōr ceyyum aṟivilceyalkaṇṭu oṟuttalum aracu muṟi yātalāl, “aṟintaṉi aruḷāy” eṉṟum, aruḷā toḻiyiṉ, uravōr tēyac ciṟṟiṉam palkit tuṉpamē mikuvittu uyirvāḻkkiyi iṉṉaṟpaṭuttum eṉṟaṟku, “yārivaṇ vāḻumōr” eṉṟum, itaṉi yaṟintāṟṟum ciṟappuk kuṟittu “neṭuntaki” yeṉṟum kūṟiṉār.
cēramāṉoṭu porutu uṭaṟṟi alanta pakivari maṭavareṉṟum, aṇaṅkeṉap parāvit tiṟi celattiyōri uravareṉṟum kuṟitturittaliṉ, iḵtu ōrāṟṟāl virintatu tokuttu avaṉ veṉṟic ciṟappurittavāṟu māyiṟṟu. iṉip paḻiyavurikārar, “uravariyum maṭavariyum eṉṉum iraṇṭāvatu vikārattāl tokkatu; aṟivu. avarkaḷaṟivu; vāḻumōr eṉpuḻi ummi acinili” eṉpar. vāḻumōr eṉpatu “uṇarumōr” eṉpatu pōlum taṉiccollātaliṉ, ummi etirkālapporuṭṭāyatōr iṭiccol leṉavumām.
itukāṟum kūṟiyatu: peruma, niṉ uṭaṟṟiyōr, kaṭuntēṟu uṟukiḷi tuñcum ceḻuṅkūṭu kiḷitta iḷantuṇi makāariṉ alantaṉar; urutteḻuntu uriiya eri ūr kavara, puki mātiram maṟippa, āreyil tōṭṭi vuviṉi; atukaṇṭa āṉpayam vāḻnar añci ēṟoṭu kaṉṟuṭi āyam tantārāka, niṉ iḷiyar pukal ciṟantu aṅki viṭuppa, avar talivaṉāṉa kaḻuvuḷ nāṇi, vikaṟ poḻutiṟ pōntu tali maṭaṅki niṉṟāṉāka, nī vēṟu pulam paṭarntu ceṉṟu, tarārāya pakivar parāvaliṉ, avar tanta tiṟikoṇṭu peyarti; niṉ ṉūḻi vāḻka; ivvāṟu uravaru maṭavarum aṟivu terin teṇṇi aruḷāyāyiṉ, neṭuntaki, ivaṇ vāḻumōr yār? oruvaru milarāvar eṉak kūṭṭi viṉimuṭivu ceyka.
iṉip paḻiyavurikārar, “āreyil tōṭṭi vuvi, ataṉiyuṭiya kaḻuvuḷ talimaṭaṅkukiyālē pulam paṭarntu, avvēṟu pulattu niṉakku yāṉiyoṭu aruṅkalam tiṟi yiṭār viruntiṉ vāḻkkiyoṭu peruntiru vaṟṟateṉak karutit taṅkaḷ meynnaṭukkamikku niṉṉi aṇaṅkeṉak karutip palapaṭap paravutalāṉ, pēy tāṉ paṟṟiṉā ruyiri vuvātu taṉakku avar paliyiṭṭuḻi appali koṇṭu peyarumāṟupōla, nīyum avaruyiri vuvātu tiṟikoṇṭu peyarā niṉṟāy; iḵtaṉṟē nī itupoḻutu ceykiṉṟatu; niṉṉi yuṭaṟṟiyōr kaṭuntēṟu uṟukiḷi tuñcum kūṭu kiḷitta iḷantuṇi makārippōla, perumāṉē, alantārkaḷ; iṉimēl uḷḷattu uravariyum maṭavariyum avaravar aṟiviṉit terinteṇṇi, avarkaḷiṭattuc ceyyum aruḷaṟintu aruḷāyāyiṉ, neṭuntakāy, ivaṇ vāḻpavar yār? niṉṉūḻi vāḻka eṉak kūṭṭi viṉimuṭivu ceyka,” eṉṟum, “itaṉāṟ colliyatu avaṉ veṉṟic ciṟappuk kūṟi avaṟkup pakivarmēl aruḷ piṟappitta vāṟāyiṟ” ṟeṉṟum kūṟuvar.
2. urutteḻu veḷḷam
1.	ikalperu miyiṟ paṭikō ḷañcār
	cūḻātu tuṇita lallatu vaṟituṭaṉ
	kāva letirār kaṟuttōr nāṭuniṉ
	muṉṟiṇi mutalvark kōmpiṉa ruṟintu
5.	maṉpati kāppa vaṟivu valiyuṟuttu
	naṉṟaṟi yuḷḷattuc cāṉṟō raṉṉaniṉ
	paṇpunaṉ kaṟiyār maṭamperu miyiṉ
	tuñca luṟūum pakalpuku māli
	nilampoṟi yorāanīr ñemaravan tīṇṭi
10.	uravuttiri kaṭukiya vurutteḻu veḷḷam
	variyā mātirat tiruḷcērpu parantu
	ñāyiṟu paṭṭa vakaṉṟuvaru kūṭṭat
	tañcāṟu puriyu niṉṟoḻi loḻittuc
	ceñcuṭar nikaḻviṟ poṅkupicir nuṭakkiya
15.	maṭaṅkaṟ ṟīyi ṉiyi
	ciṉaṅkeḻu kuruciṉiṉ ṉuṭaṟṟici ṉōrkkē.
tuṟi	:	centuṟip pāṭāṇpāṭṭu
vaṇṇam	:	oḻuku vaṇṇam
tūkku	:	centūkku
peyar	:	urutteḻu veḷḷam
3-7. niṉmuṉṟiṇi .......... perumiyiṉ
uri :
niṉ muṉ tiṇi mutalvarkku - niṉ kuṭiyil niṉakku muṉṉē viḷaṅkiya muṉṉōrkaḷukku; ōmpiṉar uṟintu - pātukāppā yiruntu; maṉpati kāppa aṟivu valiyuṟuttum - makkaṭ kūṭṭattip purattaṟku vēṇṭum neṟimuṟikaḷi aṟivuṟuttum; naṉṟu aṟi uḷḷattu - aṟamē kāṇum uḷḷatti yuṭiya; cāṉṟōr aṉṉa - amiccar pōṉṟa cūḻccivaṉmi paṭitta; niṉpaṇpu - niṉatu iyalpiṉi; maṭam perumiyiṉ - aṟiyāmi mika vuṭiyarātalāl; naṉku aṟiyār - teḷiya aṟiyārāyiṉar niṉ pakivar eṉṟavāṟu.
aracarkku “uṟṟanōy nīkki uṟāami muṟkākkum peṟṟiyār” (kuṟaḷ. 442) eṉṟaṟku, “mutalvarkku ōmpiṉa ruṟintu” eṉṟum, kuṭi yōmpal iṟimāṭci yātaliṉ, “maṉpati kāppa” eṉṟum, ataṟku vēṇṭum neṟimuṟikaḷi uṟṟaviṭattuk kaḻaṟik kūṟutalum avarkkiyalpātalpaṟṟi, “aṟivu valiyuṟuttum” eṉṟum, aṟam vaḻuviyavaḻi araciyal naṉku naṭavātākaliṉ, ataṉiyē tērntuṇarum avvamiccar maṉappāṉmiyi, “naṉṟaṟi yuḷḷattuc cāṉṟōr” eṉṟum, avaratu cūḻcci muṟṟum ic cēramāṉpāl ceṟintirukku
māṟu tōṉṟa avari uvamamāka niṟuttiyum kūṟiṉār. pakivēn tarum cūḻcciyuṭiyarāyiṉum aṟiyāmi mikavuṭiya reṉṟaṟku “maṭam perumiyiṉ” eṉṟum, ataṉāl niṉ paṇpum valiyum aṟintilar eṉṟaṟku “niṉ paṇpu naṉkaṟiyār” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. aṟivu valiyuṟuttum cāṉṟōr, uḷḷattuc cāṉṟōr eṉa iyiyum. paḻiyavurikārarum, “maṉpati makkaṭ paṉmi” yeṉṟum, “aṟivu valiyuṟuttum  cāṉṟōr eṉak kūṭṭuka” eṉṟum, īṇṭuc “cāṉṟōreṉṟatu mantirikaḷi” yeṉṟum kūṟuvar. maṭameṉṉum eḻuvāy perumiyiṉ eṉṉum payaṉili koṇṭatu.
8-16. tuñcal .............. uṭaṟṟici ṉōrkkē
uri :
tuñcal uṟūum pakal pukum māli - ellāvuyirkaḷum oruṅku aḻitaṟkuriya ūḻikkālamāṉatu pukukiṉṟa poḻutil; nilam poṟi orāa - nilamakaḷ cumi nīṅka; nīr ñemara vantu īṇṭi - nīr parantu vantu perukutalāl; uravuttiri kaṭukiya - paranteḻum alikaḷ viriyum; urutteḻu veḷḷam - nilat tuyirkaḷik kōṟaṟkuc ciṉan teḻuvatupōlum veḷḷam; variyā mātirattu - elli variyaṟukkappaṭāta tici muḻutum; iruḷ cērpu parantu - iruḷoṭu cērntu paravuvatāl; akaṉṟuvaru ñāyiṟu paṭṭa kūṭṭattu - iruḷip pōkkutaṟkup paṉṉiraṇṭāy virintu varum ñāyiṟukaḷ tōṉṟiya kūṭṭattiṉatu; ceñcuṭar nikaḻviṉ - civanta veyil nikaḻcciyiṉiyum; poṅku picir nuṭakkiya - mikukiṉṟa piciriṉiyuṭiya av veḷḷatti vaṟṟac ceyta; maṭaṅkal tīyiṉ - vaṭavit tīyiṉiyum; ciṉam keḻukurucil - ciṉam poruntiya kurucilē; am cāṟu puriyum niṉ toḻil - aḻakiya viḻāviṉippōla iṉpam ceyyum niṉṉuṭiya toḻili; oḻittu - vilakki; niṉ uṭaṟṟi ciṉōrkku aṉiyi - niṉṉip pakittup poruvārkku ottirukkiṉṟāy eṉṟavāṟu.
kūṭṭattuc ceñcuṭar nikaḻviṉiyum tīyiṉiyum aṉiyi eṉa iyiyum. kurucil, niṉ uṭaṟṟiciṉōrkku maṭaṅkaṟṟīyiṉ aṉiyi eṉa iyittu muṭikka. orāa eṉpataṉi oruva veṉṟum, ñemara veṉpataṉi ñemarn teṉṟum, īṇṭi yeṉpataṉi īṇṭa veṉṟum paranteṉpa taṉip paravaveṉṟum tirittuk koḷka. paḻiyavuri
kārarum “orāa veṉṟataṉi oruva veṉat tirittu īṇṭi yeṉṟataṉiyum īṇṭaveṉat tirikka” eṉṟum, “veḷḷam paranteṉṟataṉi parakkaveṉat tirittu ataṉi nuṭakkiya
veṉa niṉṟa ceyyiya veṉṉum viṉiyeccattōṭu muṭittu, ataṉic cuṭar nikaḻvu eṉṉum toḻiṟpeyaroṭu muṭittu, veḷḷam parakkiyālē avveḷḷatti māykka
vēṇṭic cuṭar nikaḻtali yuṭittāṉa tīyeṉa vurikka” eṉṟum kūṟutal kāṇka.
ellā vuyirkaḷum oruṅku maṭiyum ūḻikkālattit, “tuñcal uṟūum pakal” eṉṟār. iruḷ paṭarum muṭivukkāla mātalāl, “māli” yeṉṟār. ittakiyatoru kālam varutal, nilamakaṭkuc cumi nīkkam kuṟitteṉṟaṟku, “nilam poṟi yorāa” eṉṟum, taṉṉil mūḻkimaṟiyāta iṭamum poruḷum illiyeṉṉumāṟu nīr parattalāl, “nīr ñemara vantīṇṭi” eṉṟum, avveḷḷam kaṭukap paranteḻutaṟkuc cūṟikkāṟṟu mōtutalāl pēralikaḷ tōṉṟik kaṭukivaruvatu uyirkaṇmēṟ ciṉaṅkoṇṭu poṅki varuvatu pōṟaliṉ, “uravuttiri kaṭukiya vurutteḻu veḷḷam” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. “tuñcal, ellā vuyirum paṭuta” leṉṟum, “pakaleṉṟatu ūḻiyi” yeṉṟum, “māli yeṉṟatu ūḻi muṭiviṉi” yeṉṟum, “urutteḻu veḷḷameṉṟatu palluyiriyum oruṅku tāṉ kollum karuttuṭiyatu
pōlak kōpitteḻu veḷḷa meṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “icciṟappāṉē itaṟku urutteḻu veḷḷameṉṟu peyarāyiṟ” ṟeṉṟum paḻiyavurikārar kūṟukiṉṟār.
ñāyiṟu mutaliya kōḷkaḷum ēṉi viṇmīṉkaḷum tōṉṟāvāṟu tiṇiyiruḷ parantuviṭutalāl ticiyaṟiyalākā miyiṉ, “variyā mātirattu” eṉṟum, iruḷ paravumpōtē veḷḷantāṉum uṭaṉ parantu viṭumāṟu tōṉṟa, “iruḷ cērpu parantu” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. iruḷeṉpuḻi uṭaṉi kaḻccip poruṭṭāya oṭu vurupu vikārattāṟ ṟokkatu.
akaṉṟuvaru ñāyiṟu paṭṭa kūṭṭattu eṉa māṟi iyikka. ivvūḻiyiruḷip pōkki nīrpperukkiṉi vaṟṟacceytaṟku oru ñāyiṟu amiyāmipaṟṟip paṉṉiru ñāyiṟukaḷ palvēṟiṭaṅkaḷil kūṭṭamāyt tōṉṟip pēroḷiyum peruveppamum ceytalāl. “akaṉṟuvaru ñāyiṟu paṭṭa kūṭṭattuc ceñcuṭar nikaḻviṉ” eṉṟār. paṭutal, tōṉṟutal. akalutal virital; “aḵki yakaṉṟa vaṟiveṉṉām” (kuṟaḷ. 175) eṉṟāṟpōla.
poṅku picir eṉa veḷḷattic cuṭṭik kūṟiṉār, picir vaṟṟuvatupōla ivvūḻi veḷḷam vaṭavit tīyāl vaṟṟumāṟu tōṉṟa. nuṭakkiya veṉpataṉic ceyyiya veṉṉum viṉiyeccamākak koṇṭu “nikaḻviṉ” eṉpataṉōṭu muṭippar, paḻiyavurikārar.
“ñāyiṟu paṭṭa akaṉṟuvaru kūṭṭattuc ceñcuṭar nikaḻ” viṉāl, tiṇiyiruḷ keṭuvatupōla, cēraṉatu koṟṟa voḷiyiṉāl pakiyiruḷ keṭutal paṟṟiyum, maṭaṅkaṟ ṟīyāl urutteḻu veḷḷam vaṟṟuvatupōla, pakivaratu kaṭalmaruḷ perumpaṭi keṭṭaḻital paṟṟiyum “ceñcuṭar nikaḻviṉ maṭaṅkaṟ ṟīyiṉ aṉiyi” eṉṟār. iṉi, “poṅku picir nuṭakkiya ceñcuṭar nikaḻviṉ” eṉṟa pāṭamē koṇṭu, urutteḻu veḷḷattiṉ poṅkukiṉṟa picirik keṭutta ceñcuṭar nikaḻviṉiyum, maṭaṅkaṟ ṟīyiṉiyum aṉiyi eṉpatē nēriya muṟiyāta laṟika. ceñcuṭar nikaḻvu pēriruḷip pōkkip picirppaṭalattik keṭukka, maṭaṅkaṟṟī veḷḷattic cuvaṟac ceyyumeṉa vaṟika.
ik kūṟiyavāṟṟāl, ciṉaṅkeḻu kurucil, niṉ uṭaṟṟici ṉōrkku, cāṟu puriyum niṉ toḻiloḻittu, tuñcaluṟū um pakalpuku māli, ñāyiṟupaṭṭa akaṉṟuvaru kūṭṭattuc ceñcuṭar nikaḻviṉiyum, poṅku picir nuṭakkiya maṭaṅkaṟ ṟīyiṉiyum aṉiyi eṉa muṭikka. viḻākkālam naṇiyār, cēyār, ciṟiyār, periyār, uṭiyār, illār, iḷiyār, mutiyār ellārkkum iṉpam ceytal pōlac cēramāṉum ellārkkum taṉ āṭciyāl iṉpam ceytaliṉ, “amcāṟu puriyum niṉ toḻil” eṉṟār. iṉpañ ceyvatit tavirttup pakivarkkut tuṉpam ceytal paṟṟi, “niṉtoḻil oḻittu...... aṉiyi” yeṉṟār. oḻit teṉṉum viṉiyeccam aṉiyiyeṉṉum kuṟippuviṉi koṇṭatu. ākkam varuvittuk koḷka.
1-3. ikal ......... nāṭu
uri :
kaṟuttōr - niṉṉip pakittavar; ikalperumiyiṉ paṭi kōḷ añcār - karuttil pakimi peri tāyiruttalpaṟṟip paṭiyeṭuttaṟku añcārāy; cūḻātu tuṇital allatu - kālam iṭam vali mutaliyavaṟṟi ārāyāmal pōr ceyyat tuṇivatēyaṉṟi; nāṭu - tam nāṭṭi; uṭaṉ kāval vaṟitu etirār - palarāyk kūṭik kāttaṟkuc ciṟitum māṭṭārāvarkāṇ eṉṟavāṟu.
ikal, māṟupāṭu. iḵtu uḷḷattē mikkavaḻi, aṟivu toḻil ceyyāmiyiṉ, ciṉattiṟ kiriyāki mēl viḷiyum payaṉum ārāyntilar eṉpār, “ikal perumiyiṉ paṭikōḷ añcār” eṉṟum, “cūḻātu tuṇita lallatu” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. cūḻntavaḻit tamatu ciṟumiyum niṉ perumiyum iṉitu teḷintu viḷiyak kaṭava tuṉpat tukkum paḻikkum añcuva reṉpār, “añcā” reṉṟum, palarāyk kūṭik kākkiṉum kāval nirampātu eṉṟaṟku “uṭaṉ kāvaletirār” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. oru ciṟitu pōtum avarāl etirttu niṟka muṭiyātu eṉpatu “vaṟitu” eṉpataṉāl vaṟpuṟuttappaṭukiṟatu. paḻiyavurikārar, “ikal perumiyiṉ eṉpataṟku ikalāṉatu peritākiyāṉē” eṉṟum, “ikaleṉ ṉum eḻuvāykkup perumiyi viṉinilippayaṉiliyākak koḷka” eṉṟum, “añcā reṉpatu viṉiyeccamuṟ” ṟeṉṟum, “paṭikōḷit tuṇitaleṉak kūṭṭuka,” veṉṟum, “uṭaṉkāva letirāreṉṟatu, palarum tammuṭ kūṭiyum kākkamāṭṭā reṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum kūṟuvar.
itukāṟum kūṟiyatu: ciṉaṅkeḻu kuricil, niṉṉik kaṟuttavar, ikal perumiyiṉ paṭikōḷañcārāyc cūḻātu tuṇitalallatu nāṭu uṭaṉ kāval etirār; maṭam perumiyiṉ niṉ paṇpu naṉkaṟiyār; niṉ uṭaṟṟiciṉōrkku, niṉ toḻi loḻittu, nī tuñcaluṟūum pakal puku māli, urutteḻu veḷḷam paravutalāl, akaṉṟu varukūṭṭattuc ceñcuṭar nikaḻviṉiyum maṭaṅkaṟ ṟīyiṉiyum aṉiyi yākiṉṟāy eṉṟu viṉimuṭivu ceyka. paḻiyavurikārar, “niṉṉoṭu kaṟuttōr tam maṭam perumiyāl niṉ muṉkuṭi mutalvarkku aṟivu valiyuṟuttum cāṉṟōri yotta niṉ cūḻccip paṇpuṭimi yaṟikiṉṟilar; nītāṉ cūḻcciyuṭiyiyē yaṉṟik kurucilē, niṉṉuṭaṟṟiciṉōrkkup pōr ceyyumiṭattu maṭaṅkaṟ ṟīyiṉ aṉiyi; ataṉiyum aṟikiṉṟila rātalāl, avar tam ikal perumiyāṉē añcārāyp paṭikōḷit tuṇitalallatu nāṭṭic ciṟitum uṭaṉkāvaletir koḷḷār eṉak kūṭṭi viṉimuṭivu ceyka,” eṉa muṭippar.
“itaṉāṟ colliyatu, avaṉ cūḻcciyuṭimiyum veṉṟic ciṟappum uṭaṉ kūṟiyavāṟāyiṟṟu,” eṉpatu paḻiyavuri.
3. niṟantikaḻ pāciḻi
1.	uravō reṇṇiṉu maṭavō reṇṇiṉum
	piṟarkku nīvāyi ṉallatu niṉakkup
	piṟaruvama mākā voruperu vēntē....
	marutañ cāṉṟa malartali viḷivayaṟ
5.	ceyyu ṇāri yoyyu makaḷir
	iravum pakalum pāciḻi kaḷiyār
	kuṟumpal yāṇark kuravi yayarum
	kāviri maṇṭiya cēyviri vaṉappiṟ
	pukāarc celva pūḻiyar meymmaṟi
10.	kaḻivirin teḻutaru maḻitavaḻ neṭuṅkōṭṭuk
	kollip poruna koṭittērp poṟiyaniṉ
	vaḷaṉu māṇmiyuṅ kivaṇ miyum
	mānta raḷaviṟan taṉaveṉap paṉṉāḷ
	yāṉceṉ ṟurippavun tēṟār piṟarum
15.	cāṉṟō rurippavun teḷikuvar kolleṉa
	āṅkumati maruḷak kāṇkuval
	yāṅkurip pēṉeṉa varuntuval yāṉē.
tuṟi	:	centuṟip pāṭāṇpāṭṭu
vaṇṇam	:	oḻuku vaṇṇam
tūkku	:	centūkku
peyar	:	niṟantikaḻ pāciḻi
1-3. uravōr .......... vēntē
uri :
uravōr eṇṇiṉum maṭavōr eṇṇiṉum - aṟivuṭi yōri yeṇṇiṉālum aḵtu illāta maṭavōri yeṇṇiṉālum; piṟarkku nī uvamam vāyiṉallatu - piṟarkku nī uvamamāka vāyppataṉṟi; niṉakkup piṟar uvamamākā - niṉakkup piṟar uvamamākalākāta; oru peru vēntē - oppaṟṟa perumiyi yuṭiya vēntē eṉṟavāṟu.
uyarntōr maṭavōr eṉṟa irutiṟattōr perumi kūṟaluṟuvārkku avariṉ uyarntōri yuvamamāka vurittal vēṇṭu meṉpatu poruḷilakkaṇa mātaliṉ (tol. uvama. 3), uyarvaṟa vuyarnta niṉṉiyē avarkaṭku uvamamāka vurittaṟ kamintaṉi yeṉpār, “piṟarkku nī vāyiṉallatu niṉakkup piṟaruvama mākā vēntē” yeṉṟum, ākāmikku ētu niṉatu uyarvaṟa vuyarnta perumi yeṉpār, “oru peru vēntē” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. uravōr, paṭi maṭampaṭutalaṟiyāta aṟivuttiṇmi yuṭiyōr; maṭavōr, koṭikkaṇ maṭampaṭuvar; “koṭimaṭam paṭutalallatu, paṭimaṭam paṭāṉ piṟar paṭimayak kuṟiṉē” (puṟam. 142) eṉṟu cāṉṟōr kūṟutal kāṇka. perumi, uyarvu kuṟittu niṉṟatu. iṉi uravōrtām eṇṇiṉum maṭavōrtām eṇṇiṉum, irutiṟattōrum niṉṉiyē uvamamākak koṇṭurippa reṉṟumām.
4-9. marutam ........... meymmaṟi
uri :
marutam cāṉṟa - maruta vaḷam aminta; malar tali viḷi vayaṟ ceyyuḷ - virinta iṭattiyuṭiya viḷipulaṅkaḷākiya kaḻaṉikkaṇṇē yulavum; nāri oyyum makaḷir - nārikaḷi yōppum makaḷir; iravum pakalum pāciḻi kaḷiyār - iravu pakaleṉṟa irupōtiṉum tāmaṇinta paciya poṉṉāṟ ceyta iḻikaḷik kaḷiyārāy; kuṟumpal yāṇark kuravi yayarum - oṉṟaṟkoṉṟu aṇittāyp palavākiya iṭaṅkaḷilē putiya putiya kuravik kūttiṉi yāṭi makiḻum; kāviri maṇṭiya - kāviriyāṟṟiṉ nīr mikkuḷḷa; cēy viri vaṉappiṉ - neṭuntolivilēyē virintu tōṉṟum aḻakiṉiyuṭiya; pukārc celva - pukār nakarattiyuṭiya celvaṉē; pūḻiyar meymmaṟi - pūḻināṭṭārkku meypuku karuvi pōṉṟavaṉē eṉṟavāṟu.
marutattiṇik kuriya poruḷ palavum kuṟivaṟa niṟin tirukkumāṟu tōṉṟa, “marutañ cāṉṟa malartali viḷivayal” eṉṟum, āṅkuṟiyum uḻavar makaḷir vayaṟkaṇ viḷipayiri nārikaḷ mitittuc citikkāvaṇṇam ōppum ceykiyiṉarā tali, “ceyyuḷ nāri yoyyum makaḷir,” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. vittiya voṉṟu āyiramāka viḷitaliṉ, celvak kaḷippāl iravu pakal eññāṉṟum viḷiyāṭṭiṉi virumpi yoḻuku kiṉṟā reṉpār, “iravum pakalum pāciḻi kaḷiyār, kuṟumpal yāṇark kuravi yayarum” eṉṟār. paḻiyavurikārar, “iravum pakalum kuraviyayaru meṉak kūṭṭuka” veṉṟum, “maruta meṉṟatu, marutanilat taṉmiyi” yeṉṟum, “kuṟumpal kuravi yeṉṟatu, oṉṟu āṭum iṭattiṟku oṉṟu aṇiyatāy avitām palavā yirukkiṉṟa kuravi yeṉṟavāṟu” eṉṟum, “kuravi yayarum pukār eṉavum, kāviri maṇṭiya pukār eṉavum kūṭṭuka” eṉṟum kūṟuvar.
kāviri pāytalāl nīrvaḷam ciṟattaliṉ, vāṉaḷāva vuyarnta cōlikaḷum koṭimāṭap perumaṉikaḷum cēymik kaṇṇē kāṇpārkku aḻakiya tamatu kāṭciyiṉi vaḻaṅkum ciṟappu viḷaṅka, “cēyviri vaṉappiṟ pukār” eṉṟum, ataṉāṟ celva mikuti tōṉṟa, “celva” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. pūḻiyar, pūḻi nāṭṭār; in nāṭum cērark kuriyatu; “palvēṟ pūḻiyar kōvē” (patiṟ. 84) eṉṟu piṟarum cēravēntarik kūṟutal kāṇka.
10-11. kaḻi ............... poṟiya
uri :
kaḻi virintu eḻutaru - mūṅkilkaḷ virinteḻukiṉṟa; maḻi tavaḻ neṭuṅkōṭṭu - mēkaṅkaḷ tavaḻum neṭiya ucciyi yuṭiya; kollip poruna - kollimalikkut talivaṉē; koṭit tērp poṟiya - koṭiyuyarttiya tērkaḷiyuṭiya malināṭṭaracē eṉṟavāṟu.
mūṅkilkaḷ virintu vaḷarum iyalpiṉavātaliṉ, “virin teḻutaru” eṉṟār. kolli, kollimali; itaṉic cūḻntanāṭu, kollikkūṟṟameṉṟum vaḻaṅkum. poṟi, mali. cēranāṭu malināṭātaliṉ, cērar poṟiya reṉavum kūṟappaṭuvar.
11-17. niṉ vaḷaṉum .............. yāṉē
uri :
niṉ vaḷaṉum āṇmiyum kivaṇmiyum māntar aḷaviṟantaṉa eṉa - niṉṉuṭiya celvamum vīramum koṭiyum makkaḷ ārāycciyelliyik kaṭantaṉavākum eṉṟu; yāṉ paṉṉāḷ ceṉṟu urippavum tēṟār - yāṉ palanāḷum ceṉṟu urittēṉākavum niṉ pakivar teḷiyārāyiṉār; piṟarum cāṉṟōr urippat teḷikuvar kolleṉa - piṟarākiya cāṉṟōrik koṇṭu terivippiṉ avar teḷivareṉa muyaṉṟavaḻiyum; āṅkum matimaruḷak kāṇ kuval - appōḻtum avar aṟivumayaṅki yiruppatiyē kaṇṭēṉ; yāṅku urippēṉ eṉa yāṉ varuntuval - ataṉāl avarkaṭku evvāṟu kūṟit teḷivikka muṭiyu meṉṟu niṉintu varuntukiṉṟēṉ eṉṟavāṟu.
vaḷam mutaliyaṉa muṟiyē poruḷvali, taṉ tōḷ vali, tuṇivali, paṭivali mutaliyavaṟṟic cuṭṭi niṟṟalāl, ivaṟṟit tām eṭuttōtiyavāṟṟi, “māntar aḷaviṟantaṉa veṉap paṉṉāḷ yāṉ ceṉṟurippavum” eṉṟār. orunāḷoḻiyiṉum paṉṉāḷurippiṉ aṟivu teḷikuva reṉṉum tuṇivāl, “paṉṉāḷ ceṉṟu urippavum tēṟār” eṉṟār. “urippavum eṉṟa ummi tāmē aṟiyak kaṭavataṉi yām collavum aṟikilareṉac ciṟappummi”, eṉṟum, “piṟarum eṉṟa vummi acinili” yeṉṟum paḻiyavurikārar kūṟuvar. kūṟappaṭum poruḷi nōkkātu kūṟuvōr takuti nōkkum melliyar pōlum eṉṟu karutip piṟarākiya cāṉṟōri viṭuttavaḻiyum, avarpāl mayakkamē pulappaṭuvatāyiṟ ṟeṉpār, “āṅkum matimaruḷak kāṇkuval” eṉṟum, attuṇi maṭami niṟintōri oṟuppatu aṟa mākātākaliṉ, avarporuṭṭu iraṅkuvatallatu piṟi toṉṟum ceytaṟ kiṉmiyiṉ, “varuntuval yāṉē” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. yāṅ kurippēṉeṉa mīṭṭum avar kaṭkut takuvaṉa kūṟit teruṭṭaṟkaṇ tam viḻiviruppatip pulappaṭuttuvataṉāl, avarpāl aruḷaliyē vēṇṭiṉā reṉpatu karuttāyiṟṟu.
“cāṉṟōr urippat teḷikuvar kolleṉa eṉṟataṉ piṉ, karutiṉ eṉa oru col varuvittu ataṉik kāṇkuva leṉṉum viṉiyoṭu muṭikka” eṉpar paḻiyavurikārar.
itukāṟuṅ kūṟiyatu: oruperu vēntē, pukārc celva, pūḻiyar meymmaṟi, kollip poruna, koṭittērp poṟiya, niṉvaḷaṉum āṇmiyum ki vaṇmiyum māntar aḷaviṟantaṉa eṉappaṉṉāḷ ceṉṟu yāṉ urippavum niṉ pakivar tēṟār; piṟa cāṉṟōrurippat teḷikuvar kolleṉa muyaṉṟavaḻi āṅkum mati maruḷak kāṇkuval; yāṅkurippēṉ eṉa varuntuval: ākavē avari aṟiyāmi yuṭiyar eṉṟeṇṇi aruḷutal vēṇṭum eṉṟu muṭikka. iṉip paḻiyavuri, “peru vēntē, pukārc celva, pūḻiyar meymmaṟi, kollip poruna, poṟiya, niṉ pakivar niṉvaḷaṉum āṇmiyum kivaṇmiyum ulakattu makkaḷ aḷavik kaṭantaṉa; avaṉoṭu māṟupaṭuvatu numakku  uṟutiyaṉṟeṉap paṉṉāḷ yāṉ collavum tēṟiṟṟilar; tēṟārāyiṉum ulakattu matippuṭiya cāṉṟōr collat tām tēṟuvarō veṉak karutiṉ avar coṉṉaviṭattum avarkaḷ matimaruṇṭatuvē kāṇāniṉṟēṉ; ākalāṉ niṉ perumiyi avarkaṭku yāṅkurippēṉeṉa varuntā niṉṟēṉ yāṉ; iḵtu eṉṉuṟu kuṟi; itaṉi yaṟintu nī avarpāl aruḷa vēṇṭuvaleṉa viṉimuṭivu ceyka,” eṉṟu kūṟum.
“itaṉāṟ colliyatu, avaṉ veṉṟikku aṭiyākiya celvamum nuṇmiyum kivaṇmiyum uṭaṉ kūṟiya vāṟṟāṉ avaṉ veṉṟic ciṟappuk kūṟiyavāṟāyiṟṟu”.
`niṟantikaḻ pāciḻi’ eṉṟa toṭaraminta mūlappakuti kiṭittilatu.
4. nalampeṟu tirumaṇi
1.	kēḷvi kēṭṭup paṭiva moṭiyātu
	vēḷvi vēṭṭaṉi yuyarntō ruvappac
	cāyaṟal kaṭukkun tāḻiruṅ kūntal
	vēṟupaṭu tiruvi ṉiṉvaḻi vāḻiyar
5.	koṭumaṇam paṭṭa viṉimā ṇaruṅkalam
	pantarp payanta palarpukaḻ muttam
	variyaka naṇṇik kuṟumpoṟi nāṭit
	teriyunar koṇṭa ciraṟuṭip pimpoṟik
	kavimaraṅ kaṭukkuṅ kavaliya maruppiṟ
10.	puḷḷi yiralit tōlū ṉutirttut
	tītukaḷin teñciya tikaḻviṭu pāṇṭiṟ
	paruti pōkiya puṭikiḷi kaṭṭi
	eḵkuṭi yirumpi ṉuḷḷamittu vallōṉ
	cūṭu niliyuṟṟuc cuṭarviṭu tōṟṟam
15.	vicumpāṭu marapiṟ paruntū ṟaḷappa
	nalampeṟu tirumaṇi kūṭṭu naṟṟōḷ
	oṭuṅkī rōti yoṇṇutal karuvil
	eṇṇiyaṉ muṟṟi yīraṟivu purintu
	cālpum cemmiyu muḷappaṭap piṟavum
20.	kāvaṟ kaminta varacutuṟi pōkiya
	vīṟucāl putalvaṟ peṟṟaṉi yivaṇark
	karuṅkaṭa ṉiṟutta ceruppukaṉ muṉpa
	aṉṉavi maruṇṭaṉe ṉallē ṉiṉvayiṉ
	muḻutuṇarn toḻukku narimū tāḷaṉi
25.	vaṇmiyu māṇpum vaḷaṉu meccamum
	teyvamum yāvatun tavamuṭi yōrkkeṉa
	vēṟupaṭu naṉantalip peyarak
	kūṟiṉi perumaniṉ paṭimi yāṉē.
tuṟi	:	centuṟip pāṭāṇpāṭṭu
vaṇṇam	:	oḻuku vaṇṇam
tūkku	:	centūkku
peyar	:	nalampeṟu tirumaṇi
3-17. cāyaṟal .......... karuvil
uri :
cāy aṟal kaṭukkum - nuṇṇiya karumaṇali yokkum; tāḻ iruṅ kūntal - tāḻnta kariya kūntaliyum; koṭumaṇam paṭṭa viṉi māṇ aruṅkalam - koṭumaṇam eṉṉum ūrilē uṇṭākiya ariya kalaṉkaḷiyum; pantar payanta palar pukaḻ muttam - pantar eṉṉum ūriṭattē peṟṟa palarum pukaḻkiṉṟa muttukkaḷiyum; vari yakam naṇṇi - perumali
kaḷi yaṭintu avaṟṟiṭattum; kuṟumpoṟi nāṭi - ciṟu ciṟu malikaḷi yaṭintu avaṟṟiṭattum tēṭi; teriyunar koṇṭa -  kuṟṟamaṟa ārāyntukoḷḷum aṟiviṉi yuṭiyōr koṇṭa; ciraṟuṭip pimpoṟi - citaṟik kiṭattaliyuṭiya paciya poṟikaḷiyum; kavimaram kaṭukkum kavaliya maruppiṉ - kavikkōl pōlak kiḷittali
yuṭiya kompiṉiyum; puḷḷi iralittōl - puḷḷiyiṉiyu muṭiya māṉtōlik koṇṭu; ūṉ utirttu - ataṉ uṭpuṟattut taciyik kaḷintu; tītu kaḷintu - ēṉi aḻukkukaḷiyum pōkki; eñciya tikaḻ viṭu - eñci niṉṟa oḷi vīcukiṉṟa; pāṇṭiṟ paruti pōkiya puṭi - vaṭṭamāka aṟutta tōliṉ viḷimpilē; kiḷi kaṭṭi - iṉamākac cērak kaṭṭi; eḵkuṭi irumpiṉ - kūrmiyiyuṭiya vūciyāl; vallōṉ - toḻil vallavaṉ; uḷḷamittu - uṭpuṟattē maṇikaḷip patittu aḻakuṟa aṇi ceytu; cūṭu niliyuṟṟu - cūṭutaṟkuriya nilimiyiṉi yuṟuvittu; cuṭar viṭu tōṟṟam - oḷi tikaḻkiṉṟa tōṟṟattip peṟuvittalāl; vicum pāṭu marapiṉ - vicumpilē paṟakkum muṟimiyiṉi yuṭiya; paruntu ūṟu aḷappa - paruntāṉatu ūṉeṉṟu karuti yataṉi yuṟṟuk kavartaṟku niṉiyumāṟu; nalam peṟu tirumaṇi - nalam peṟṟa uyariya at tōṟpaṇiyākiya maṇiyi; kūṭṭum naṟṟōḷ - aṇikiṉṟa nalla tōḷiṉiyum; oṭuṅkī rōti - oṭuṅkiya curuḷ eṉṉum pakutiyāṉa kūntaliyum; oṇṇutal - oḷḷiya neṟṟiyiṉiyum; vēṟupaṭu tiruviṉ - piṟappāl tirumakaḷiṉ vēṟupaṭṭā ḷeṉṉum ciṟappeytiya māṇpiṉiyumuṭiya niṉ tēviyiṉuṭiya; niṉvaḻi vāḻiyar - niṉ kuṭivaḻi nīṭu vāḻvataṉ poruṭṭu; karuvil - karuviṭattē yamintu eṉṟavāṟu.
meṉmiyum nuṇmiyu muṭimipaṟṟik karumaṇali “cāyaṟal” eṉal vēṇṭiṟṟu. tāḻ iruṅ kūntal - mutukiṭattē tāḻnta kariya kūntal;  “puṟantāḻ piruḷiya piṟaṅkukura limpāl” (akam : 126) eṉṟu piṟaruṅ kūṟutal kāṇka. kūntaliyum, tōḷiṉiyum nutaliṉiyumuṭiya tēviyiṉatu karuvil eṉak kūṭṭuka. tāḻiruṅ kūntaleṉṟavar maṟupaṭiyum oṭuṅkī rōti yeṉṟatu, kūntaliṉ nīṭciyum niṟappolivum potup paṭak kūṟi, ataṉic curuḷ eṉṉum pakutiyāka muṭikkum ciṟappiṉi yuṇarttaṟku. tirumakaṭkuriya uruvum piṟa nalaṅ kaḷum poruntip piṟappoṉṟiṉāl vēṟupaṭuvatu kuṟittut tēviyi, “vēṟupaṭu tiru” eṉṟār. vēṟupaṭu tiruviṉ eṉpataṟkup paḻiyavurikārar, “vēṟupaṭu tiruviṉ eṉṟatu, ivaḷukkuk kūṟiya kuṇaṅkaḷāl avaḷiṉ vēṟākiya niṉ tēvi eṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “tiruviṉ eṉṉum iṉ aci nili” yeṉṟum kūṟuvar.
koṭumaṇam, pantar eṉpaṉa, akkālattē ciṟappuṟṟirunta ūrkaḷ. viṉimāṇ aruṅkalam, toḻilnalattāl māṇpuṟṟa aṇikalaṉkaḷ. palar, palanāṭṭavar.
vēḷviceytaṟkaṇ, ataṉic ceyvōr nallilakkaṇam aminta puḷḷimāṉiṉ tōlit tūymiceytu pōrttuk koḷpavātaliṉ, ataṉi, māṉilakkaṇam terintārik koṇṭu peṟutal vēṇṭi viṭuttaliṉ, avarit “teriyunar” eṉṟum, avarkaḷ ataṉi nāṭip peṟumāṟu kūṟuvār. “variyakam naṇṇik kuṟumpoṟi nāṭit teriyunar” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. variyakam, perumalittoṭar. kuṟum poṟi, ciṟu kuṉṟukaḷ niṟinta malippakkam. kocci nāṭṭup pakutikaḷi iṭikkālak kalveṭṭukkaḷ neṭum poṟi nāṭeṉṟum kuṟumpoṟi nāṭeṉṟum (A.R.No. 321 of 1924) kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. ivviṭatti naṇṇi nāṭutaliṉ, uyariya māṉ vakikaḷ avviṭattē vāḻtal peṟṟām. nallilakkaṇam aminta māṉiṉnalam kūṟuvār, kiḷitta kompuṭimiyum, uṭaleṅkum citaṟiya puḷḷiyuṭimiyum vitantu, “pim poṟik kavimaram kaṭukkum kavaliya maruppiṟ puḷḷiyirali” yeṉṟār. “variyeṉṟatu perumaliyi” yeṉṟum, kuṟum poṟi yeṉṟatu “ataṉi yaṇinta ciṟu poṟṟikaḷi” yeṉṟum, “teriyunar kōṭal, ilakkaṇak kuṟṟamaṟa ārāyntu kōṭal” eṉṟum, “pimpoṟi yeṉṟatu cevvikaḷiyuṭiya puḷḷikaḷi” yeṉṟum, “mēṟ puḷḷiyirali yeṉṟataṉi ataṉ cātippeyar kūṟiyavāṟākak koḷka” eṉṟum paḻiyavuri kūṟum. ciraṟutal, citaṟutal. kavali, kavarttal.
vēḷvi ceyvōṉ māṉ tōlip pōrttukkoḷḷa, avaṉ maṉivi attōli vaṭṭamāka aṟuttu ataṉic cuṟṟilum muttukkaḷiyum piṟa vuyariya maṇikaḷiyum kaṭṭi, naṭuvē uyariya māṇikkam maṇikaḷit tittut tōḷiṭattē aṇivaḷpōlum, īṇṭu āciriyar aracamātēvi ivvāṟu aṇintāḷeṉṟaliṉ. mayir mutaliyaṉa mūṭip poliviṉṟi yirukkum pakutiyit tītu eṉa vilakkutalāl, “tītu kaḷin teñciya tikaḻviṭu pāṇṭiṟ paruti” eṉṟum, vaṭṭamāṉa tōlip “pāṇṭiṟ paruti” yeṉṟum, ataṉ viḷimpilē koṭumaṇattuk kalattiyum pantariṭattup peṟṟa muttiṉiyum iṉañcērak kaṭṭiṉāreṉṟaṟku, “puṭikiḷi kaṭṭi” yeṉṟum, uḷḷiṭattē tāmari mutaliya pūvip pōlum aḻakiya vēlippāṭṭiṉic civanta māṇikka maṇi koṇṭu  toḻil vallunar, ceytataṉi “vallōṉ eḵkuṭi yirumpiṉ uḷḷamittu” eṉṟum, avvāṟu amittalāl cūṭutaṟkuriya niliyuṟuvatāl, “cūṭu niliyuṟṟu” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. uṟuvit teṉaṟpālatu, “uṟṟu” eṉa vantatu. civanta maṇikaḷ iṭiyē patikkappeṟṟuc cevvoḷi kāṉṟu tikaḻtal kaṇṭu, ūṉeṉṟu karutip paruntu kavarntu cellak karutumeṉpār, “vicumpāṭu marapiṟ paruntū ṟaḷappa” eṉṟār. ūṉ tēṭi yuṟṟuṇṭu payiṉṟa kūriya pārvi yiṉiyuṭiya paruntiṉi mayakkumāṟu civanta oḷikoṇṭu viḷaṅkum maṇiyātalpaṟṟi, “nalam peṟu tirumaṇi” eṉap paṭṭatu. poṉṉiṭip patittup poli vuṟuttap peṟum māṇikkamaṇi,  tōliṭip patittavaḻiyum taṉ nalloḷi kuṉṟātu tikaḻum ciṟappuk kuṟittu ivvāṟu nalampeṟu tirumaṇi yeṉṟa nalattāl, ippāṭṭiṟku “nalampeṟu tirumaṇi”yeṉṟu peyarāyiṟṟeṉa vaṟika. iṉip paḻiya vurikārar, “nalampeṟu tirumaṇi yeṉṟatu maṇiyaṟivārāl ituvē nallateṉṟu collappaṭu taliyuṭiya tirumaṇi yeṉṟavāṟu; ic ciṟappāṉē itaṟku nalampeṟu tirumaṇi yeṉṟu peyarāyiṟṟu” eṉpar.
itaṉkaṭ kūṟiyavaṟṟit tokuttu nōkkiṉ, tāḻiruṅ kūntaliyum, tirumaṇi kūṭṭum naṟṟōḷiyum, ōtiyiyum, oṇṇutaliyum, vēṟupaṭu tiruviṉiyumuṭiya niṉ tēviyiṉ karuvilē eṉpatām. iṉi, ippakutikkaṇ vantavaṟṟiṟku urikkuṟippuk kūṟuluṟṟa paḻiyavurikārar, “kavaliya veṉṉum akaram ceyyuḷ vikāra” meṉṟum, pāṇṭi leṉṟatu, vaṭṭamāka aṟutta tōliṉi yeṉṟum, “paruti pōkiya puṭi yeṉṟatu, vaṭṭamākap pōṉa attōlatu viḷimpiṉi” yeṉṟum, “eḵkuṭi yirumpiṉ uḷḷamit teṉṟatu, kūrmiyiyuṭiya karuvikaḷāl attōluṭ ceyyum toḻilkaḷellām ceytamit teṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, amitteṉṟataṉi “amippaveṉat tirikka” veṉṟum, vallōṉāl eṉa virittu “vallōṉāl niṉ tēvi cūṭutal niliyuṟutalāl eṉka” eṉṟum, “vallōṉ yākam paṇṇuvikka vallavaṉ” eṉṟum, “tōṟṟa meṉṟatu, tōṟṟamuṭiya attōliṉi” yeṉṟum kūṟuvar. karuvil eṉpataṉōṭu aminteṉa oru col varuvittu, vāḻiya reṉṟa muṟṟeccattukku muṭipākkātu, “vāḻiyareṉṉum viṉiyeccattiṉic cūṭu niliyuṟṟu eṉṉum viṉiyoṭu muṭikka” eṉpar paḻiyavurikārar.
18-21. eṇṇiyal ......... peṟṟaṉi
uri :
eṇ iyal muṟṟi - eṇṇappaṭukiṉṟa tiṅkaḷ pattum nirampi; īr aṟivu purintu - iruvaki yaṟivum amintu; cālpum cemmiyum uḷappaṭap piṟavum - cālpum naṭuvu niliyu muḷḷiṭṭa piṟa naṟpaṇpukaḷum; kāvaṟ kaminta aracu tuṟi pōkiya vīṟu cāl - nāṭu kāttaṟku vēṇṭum araciya laṟivu vaki palavum muṟṟak kaṟṟuttuṟipōkiya ciṟappum niṟinta; putalvaṟ peṟṟaṉi ivaṇarkku - naṉmakaṉip peṟṟuḷḷāy in nilavulakattu vāḻvārporuṭṭu eṉṟavāṟu.
karuvaḷartaṟkuriya kālatti ovvoru tiṅkaḷāka veṇṇupavātaliṉ. “eṇṇiyal muṟṟi” yeṉṟār. īraṟivu - iruvaki yaṟivu: avi iyaṟkiyum ceyaṟkiyumākiya iru vaki yaṟivukaḷ. iyaṟkiyāya kaṇṇoḷi yillārkku ēṉi ñāyiṟṟoḷi mutaliyaṉa payaṉpaṭāmipōla. iyaṟkiyāya uṇmiyaṟivillārk kalvi kēḷvikaḷāṉām ceyaṟkiyaṟivu payaṉpaṭātākaliṉ, “īraṟivu purintu” eṉṟāreṉṟumām. immi maṟumi yaṟivukaḷumām. periya aṟiveṉiṉumamiyu meṉpar paḻiyavurikārar. cālpu, naṟkuṇaṅkaḷiṉ niṟivu; aṉpu, nāṇ, oppuravu, kaṇṇōṭṭam, vāymi eṉṟa aintiṉ niṟivu. aracāḷum tiṟaṉum karuvilē vāykkun tiruveṉṟaṟku, “kāvaṟkaminta aracu tuṟi pōkiya vīṟu” eṉṟār. piṟanta piṉpē ivi yāvum peṟaṟ kuriyavāyiṉum, ivaṟṟiṉ pēṟu iṉitu poruntutaṟkuriya nalvāyppuk karuvilē uṇṭāva tākaliṉ, ivvāṟu kūṟiṉār eṉa aṟika. ikkaruttē, “peṟumavaṟṟuḷ yāmaṟiva tilli aṟivaṟinta, makkaṭpē ṟalla piṟa” (kuṟaḷ. 61) eṉpuḻiyum amintukiṭattal kāṇka. peṟṟaṉi yeṉpatip paḻiyavuri kārar muṟṟeccamākki mēl varuvaṉavaṟṟōṭu muṭippar. aracaṉatu putalvaṟpēṟu avaṉ kōṟkīḻ vāḻvārkku ēmamātal paṟṟi, “ivaṇark” keṉṟār. makkaṭpēṟu, peṟṟōrkkē yaṉṟi ip perunilattu vāḻvārkku nalam payakkum iyalpiṟ ṟeṉpatu paṇṭit tamiḻ naṉmakkaḷ koḷki. “tammiṉtam makkaḷ aṟivuṭimi mānilattu, maṉṉuyirk kellām iṉitu” (kuṟaḷ. 68) eṉṟu cāṉṟōr kūṟutal kāṇka.
1-2. kēḷvi ......... uvappa
uri:
kēḷvi kēṭṭu - arumaṟip poruḷi aṟivar urippak kēṭṭu; paṭivam oṭiyātu - avar uritta virataṅkaḷi mēṟkoṇṭu tavirātoḻuki; uyarntōr uvappa - aṟivu oḻukkaṅkaḷāl uyarnta naṉmakkaḷ maṉamakiḻumpaṭi; vēḷvi vēṭṭaṉi - vēḷvikaḷic ceytu muṭittāy eṉṟavāṟu.
arumaṟipporuḷi oruvar tāmē kaṟṟuṇartal kūṭāmiyiṉ, “kēḷvi kēṭṭu” eṉṟār. kēḷvi, arumaṟip poruḷ; kēṭṭaṟ kuriyatu atuvākaliṉ, kēṭṭa poruḷi naṭimuṟiyil teḷintu nallaṟivu kivarap peṟutaṟku virata voḻukkam vēṇṭiyiruttalāl, “paṭiva moṭiyātu” eṉṟār. kēṭṭavaṟṟi maṉattāl oṉṟiyiruntuṇartaṟkut tuṇiceyvatu paṭivameṉa vuṇarka. vēḷvippayaṉ uyarnili yoḻukkattuc cāṉṟōrkku uvaki payappippatātalāl, “uyarntō ruvappa vēḷvi vēṭṭaṉi” yeṉṟār “āṉṟa kēḷvi yaṭaṅkiya koḷki, nāṉmaṟi mutalvar cuṟṟamāka, maṉṉa rēval ceyya maṉṉiya, vēḷvi muṟṟiya vāyvāḷ vēntē” (puṟam. 26) eṉṟu piṟarum kūṟutal kāṇka.
iṉi, paḻiyavurikārar, “kēḷvi kēṭṭal - yākam paṇṇu taṟkuṭalāṉa viti kēṭṭal; paṭivam - yākam paṇṇu taṟku uṭalāka muṉpu celuttum virataṅkaḷ. “oṭiyāteṉpati oṭiyāmal eṉat tirikka” eṉṟum, “vēṭṭaṉi eṉṟataṉi viṉiyeccamuṟṟākki avviṉiyeccattiṉi aruṅkaṭaṉ iṟutta eṉṉum viṉiyoṭu kūṭṭuka” eṉṟum, “uyarntōr tēva” reṉṟum kūṟuvar.
22-28. aruṅkaṭaṉ .......... paṭimiyāṉē
uri :
aruṅkaṭaṉ iṟutta - in nilavulakattu vāḻvārkku aracarāyiṉār ceytaṟkuriya ariya kaṭaṉkaḷic ceytu muṭitta; ceruppukal muṉpa - pōri virumpum valiyiṉiyuṭi yōy; niṉvayiṉ aṉṉavi maruṇṭaṉeṉ allēṉ - niṉpāl kēḷviyum vēḷviyum putalvaṟpēṟumākiya avi yiṟṟik kaṇṭu viyappuṟṟē ṉallēṉ; muḻutuṇarn toḻukkum narimūtāḷaṉi - uṇarat takuvaṉavaṟṟi muḻutum uṇarntu piṟarkkum uṇartti naṉṉeṟi yoḻukappaṇṇum nariyum mutumiyumuṭiya purōkitaṉi; niṉ paṭimiyāṉ - nī mēṟ koṇṭirukkum tava voḻukkattāl; vaṇmiyum  māṇpum vaḷaṉum eccamum teyvamum yāvatum tavam uṭiyōrkku eṉa - koṭiyum kuṇavamitiyum celvamum makappēṟum teyvavuṇarvum piṟavum muṉṉit tavamuṭiyārkkē yuḷavāvaṉa eṉa aṟivuṟutti; vēṟupaṭu naṉantali peyarak kūṟiṉi - nāṭṭiṉ vēṟupaṭṭa akaṉṟa iṭamākiya kāṭṭiṟkut tavaṅ kuṟittuc cellap paṇittaṉi; peruma - perumāṉē! itu kaṇṭaṉṟē yāṉmaruṭki yeytuvē ṉāyiṉēṉ eṉṟavāṟu.
aruṅkaṭaṉ iṟutta muṉpa, ceruppukal muṉpa eṉa iyiyum. makappēṟṟāl ivaṇariyum, vēḷvi vēṭṭalāl uyarntōriyum ōmputalpaṟṟi “aruṅkaṭaṉ iṟutta” eṉṟum, cerumēmpaṭṭārkkaṉṟi ivvaruṅkaṭaṉ eḷitil iṟuk kalākāmi tōṉṟa, “ceruppukal muṉpa” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. uyar poruḷi yōti yuṇarntum piṟark kurittum tāṉoḻuka vallavaṉ eṉṟaṟkup purōkitaṉi “muḻutuṇarn toḻukkum narimū tāḷaṉi” eṉṟār. narippum mutumiyu maṉṟi, vaṇmiyum māṇpu mutalāyiṉa avaṉpāl peruka uḷavātal vēṇṭic cēramāṉ irakkaṅkoṇṭu avaṟṟip peṟumāṟu aṟivukkoṭi vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ eṉpār, “vaṇmiyum māṇpum vaḷaṉum eccamum teyvamum yāvatum tavamuṭi yōrkku eṉa” aṟivuṟuttiṉāṉ eṉṟār. eccam pukaḻkkurit tāyiṉum, vaṇmiyum māṇpum kūṟavē ap pukaḻum avaṟṟiṉ pāl aṭaṅkutalāl makkaṭ pēṟāyiṟṟu. iṉip paḻiyavuri kārar, “narimūtāḷaṉi yeṉṟatu, purōkitaṉi” yeṉṟum, “nari mūtāḷaṉik kūṟiṉi yeṉak kūṭṭi avaṉic colli yēviṉiyeṉa orucol varuvittu muṭikka” eṉṟum, “māṇ peṉṟatu māṭcimiyuṭiya kuṇaṅkaḷi” yeṉṟum, “ecca meṉṟatu piḷḷippēṟṟiṉi” yeṉṟum, “teyvameṉṟatu tammāl vaḻipaṭum teyvattiṉi” eṉṟum “tavamuṭiyōrk keṉac colli yeṉka” eṉṟum, “kūṟiṉi yeṉpatu viṉi yeccamuṟ” ṟeṉṟum, “vēṟupaṭu naṉantali yeṉṟatu tuṟantu pōyirukkum kāṭṭiṉi” yeṉṟum, “peyara veṉṟatu an narimūtāḷaṉik kāṭṭilē peyara vēṇṭi” yeṉṟum kūṟuvar. 
purōkitaṉ ceṉṟa kāṭṭiṉi, “vēṟupaṭu naṉantali” yeṉṟār, aimpoṟikaḷāṉum āra nukarum nukarccikkiṭaṉākum nāṭṭiṉum, avaṟṟi yaṭakkutaṟkut tuṇiyākum ciṟappup paṟṟi vēṟupaṭutaliṉ. cēramāṉ, ivvāṟu taṉ paṭimiyāṉ purōkitaṉit tuṟavumēṟkoḷḷap paṇittami nōkkiṉ, appurōkitaṉ āṉṟavintaṭaṅkum cālpiṟ kuṟipaṭṭamiyum, ataṉi niṟittukkōṭaṟku vēntaṉ kaṇṇōṭi vēṟupaṭu naṉantalip peyarttamiyum peṟṟām. itu kaṇṭaṉṟē yeṉpatu mutalāyiṉa kuṟippeccam.
itukāṟum kūṟiyatu: ceruppukal muṉpa, peruma, tāḻiruṅ kūntaliyum, naṟṟōḷiyum, ōtiyiyum, nutaliyum tiru viṉiyumuṭiya niṉ tēviyiṉ karuvilē, iyal muṟṟi, aṟivu purintu, aracu tuṟi pōkiya putalvaṟ peṟṟaṉi ivaṇar poruṭṭu; uyarntōruvappa vēḷvi vēṭṭaṉi; aṉṉavi kaṇṭu maruṇṭaṉeṉallēṉ; nari mūtāḷaṉi, niṉpaṭimi yāṉ, vēṟupaṭu naṉantalip peyarak kūṟiṉi; itu kaṇṭaṉṟē maruṭki yeytuvēṉāyiṉēṉ eṉpatām. iṉip paḻiya vuri, “vēṭṭaṉi yeṉṟum, peṟṟaṉiyeṉṟum nī ceyta yākaṅkaḷākiya aṉṉaviyiṟṟiṟku yāṉ maruṇṭēṉallēṉ, niṉṉi nalvaḻi yoḻukuvittu niṉṟa nari mūtāḷaṉi niṉpaṭimiyāṉē illaṟa voḻukkiṉi yoḻittut tuṟavaṟa voḻukkilē cella oḻukuvittaṉi; avvāṟu ceyvitta niṉ pēroḻukkattiyum pēraṟiviṉiyum terintu yāṉ maruṇṭēṉeṉa viṉi muṭivu ceyka” eṉṟu kūṟum.
“itaṉāṟ colliyatu, avaṉ nalloḻukkamum ataṟkēṟṟa nallaṟivuṭimiyum kūṟiyavāṟāyiṟṟu.”
5. tīñcēṟṟi yāṇar
1.	irumpuli koṉṟu peruṅkaḷi ṟaṭūum
	arumpoṟi vayamā ṉaṉiyi palvēṟ
	polantār yāṉi yiyaṟērp poṟiya
	vēntarum vēḷirum piṟarum kīḻppaṇintu
5.	niṉvaḻip paṭāa rāyi ṉeṉmik(ku)
	aṟiyuṟu karumpiṉ tīñcēṟṟi yāṇar
	varunar variyā vaḷamvīṅ kirukki
	vaṉpulan taḻīiya meṉpā ṟōṟum
	marupula viṉiñar pulavikal paṭuttuk 1
10.	kaḷḷuṭi niyamat toḷvili koṭukkum
	veḷvara kuḻuta koḷḷuṭik karampic
	cennel valci yaṟiyār tattam
	pāṭal cāṉṟa vippiṉ
	nāṭuṭa ṉāṭal yāvaṇa tavarkkē.
tuṟi	:	centuṟip pāṭāṇpāṭṭu
vaṇṇam	:	oḻuku vaṇṇam
tūkku	:	centūkku
peyar	:	tīñcēṟṟiyāṇar
1-3. irumpuli .............. poṟiya
uri :
pal vēl polantār yāṉi iyal tērp poṟiya - palavākiya vēṟpaṭiyum poṉṉarimāli yaṇinta yāṉiyum iyalukiṉṟa tērumuṭiya peruñcēralirum poṟiyē; irumpuli koṉṟu - periya puliyik koṉṟu; peruṅ kaḷiṟu aṭūum - ataṉālum cōrvaṭiyātu uṭaṉ ceṉṟu periya yāṉiyik kollukiṉṟa; arum poṟi vayamāṉ aṉiyi - ariya varikaḷiyum valiyiyumuṭiya arimāviṉi oppāy; eṉṟavāṟu.
peruṅkaḷiṟṟiṉum irumpuli vali mikavuṭittātaliṉ, ataṉik koṉṟum cōrvaṭiyātē iṭiyaṟaviṉṟip peruṅkaḷiṟṟiṉiyum kollum peruvaliyuṭimi tōṉṟa “irumpuli koṉṟu peruṅkaḷiṟu aṭūum” eṉṟār. arimāviṟkup poṟiyaṉiyum, pulikku ēṉi vēntariyum peruṅkaḷiṟṟukku vēḷir mutalāyiṉāriyum koḷka. polantār, poṉṉarimāli.
4-7. vēntarum .......... vīṅkirukki
uri :
vēntarum vēḷirum piṟarum kīḻppaṇintu niṉ vaḻip paṭāa rāyiṉ - muṭivēntarum kuṟunilamaṉṉarum piṟarum niṉṉik kīḻppaṇintu niṉ viruppiṉvaḻi oḻukārāyiṉ; nel mikku - nel mikku viḷiya; aṟiyuṟu karumpiṉ tīñcēṟṟu yāṇar - ataṟkiṭiyūṟāka vaḷarntu muṟṟiyiruttal paṟṟi veṭṭappaṭṭa karumpiṉatu tīviya cāṟākiya putu varuvāyiṉi; varunar variyā vaḷam vīṅku irukki - avviṭattē varuvōrkku variyātu vaḻaṅkum celvam mikunta irukkikaḷ (ūrkaḷ) eṉṟavāṟu.
nelmikku viḷitalāl ataṉiyum, karumpiṉ tīñ cāṟu mēṉ mēlum perukutalāl ataṉiyum varuvōrkku variyātu vaḻaṅkupa eṉpatām. aṟiyuṟu karumpu. aṟuttalip poruntiya karumpu. iṟuttal iṟiyeṉa varutalpōla, aṟuttal aṟiyeṉa vantatu. nellukku vēliyāka naṭṭa karumpu mika vaḷarntu nelliṉ vaḷarcciyik keṭuttalāl, aṟukkappaṭṭa karumpu eṉṟaṟku “aṟiyuṟu karumpu” eṉṟā reṉka. paḻiya vuri kārarum, “nelmikku aṟiyuṟu karum peṉṟatu, nelliṉ kaṇṇē annelli nerukki mika eḻuntamiyāṉē aṟukka luṟṟa karumpeṉṟavāṟu” eṉṟum, “iṉi, anneṟṟāṉ karumpiṉ mika eḻuntu ataṉi nerukkiṉamiyal annelliṟku iṭa muṇṭāka aṟutta karumpu eṉiṉumām” eṉṟum urippar. variyātu vaḻaṅkiya vaḻiyum vaḷam kuṉṟāmipaṟṟi, “variyā vaḷam vīṅkirukki” eṉṟār. mikku eṉpati mika veṉat tirikka.
“tīñcēṟu iṉiya pāku” eṉṟum, “yāṇareṉṟatu, at tīñcēṟṟatu iṭiyaṟa viṉmiyi” eṉṟum, “ic ciṟappāṉē itaṟkut tīñcēṟṟiyāṇar eṉṟu peyarāyiṟ” ṟeṉṟum paḻiyavurikārar kūṟuvar.
nellukku vēliyāka naṭṭa karumpu mika vaḷarntu ataṉ vaḷarccikku iṭiyūṟāvatu kaṇṭu ataṉit taṭintupeṟṟa tīñcēṟṟiyāṇari varunarkku variyātu vaḻaṅkuvareṉṟatu, kuṭi puṟantārātu avarkku iṭiyūṟu viḷikkum koṭuṅ kōlaraci veṉṟu, avarpāṟ peṟṟa poruḷi varunarkku variyātu vaḻaṅkum cēramāṉatu naṟceyal uḷḷuṟut turittavāṟu.
8-14. vaṉpulam ................ tavarkkē
uri :
vaṉpulam taḻīiya meṉpāl tōṟum - vaṉṉilaṅkaḷic cāravuḷḷa maruta nilaṅkaḷtōṟum; marupula viṉiñar - vittiyatu muḷiyāta kaḷarnilattē toḻiliṉic ceyyum maṟavar; pulavikal paṭuttu - am marutavayalkaḷik kōṭal kuṟittu nikaḻttum māṟupāṭṭik keṭuttaḻittu; kaḷḷuṭi niyamattu oḷvili koṭukkum - avarpāṟ peṟṟuk kaḷviṟkum kaṭikaḷil kaḷḷiṟku viliyākak koṭukkum; veḷvaraku uḻuta koḷḷuṭik karampi - uḻutu vittiya veḷḷi varakum koḷḷum viḷiyum karampiyāy viṭutalāl; cennel valci aṟiyār - avvarakum koḷḷu mallatu cenneṟcōṟu peṟātu varuntupa vākaliṉ, avarkku - av vēntar mutalāyiṉārkku; tattam pāṭal cāṉṟa vippiṉ nāṭu - tattammuṭiya pulavar pāṭum pukaḻ aminta ūrkaḷi yuṭiya nāṭṭi; uṭaṉ āṭal yāvaṇatu - oruṅku āḷuvatu eṅṅaṉam kūṭum eṉṟavāṟu.
eḷitil uḻutu vittutaṟkākāta vaṉṉilattic cārntuḷḷa maruta vayalkaḷi, “vaṉpulan taḻīiya meṉpāl” eṉṟār. meṉpālil nalla viḷivu uṇṭātaliṉ, ataṉik kōṭaṟku ēṉi vaṉpulattu vāḻum marunilattār virumpi muyalpa vātalālum, akkāli meṉpulattu vāḻnar avaroṭu porupa vātalālum, appōril tōṟkum marupula viṉiñar tampāl uḷḷa varakum koḷḷum taṇṭamākat tarupavāta lālum, “marupula viṉiñar pulavikal paṭuttu” eṉṟum, at taṇṭapporuḷum kaḷvilikkē payaṉpaṭukiṟateṉpār, “kaḷḷuṭi niyamattu oḷvili koṭukkum veḷvara kuḻutakoḷ” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. marupulam, kaḷarnilam. “marunila muḻutatil eru mikap peytu, vittiṭṭāṅkē koḷḷac, cittat tuṉṉum mattar pōlavum” (tirukkaḻumala mummaṇi. 22 : 16-8) eṉap paṭṭiṉattaṭikaḷ kūṟuvatu kāṇka. vaṉpulan taḻīiya meṉpā leṉṟaliṉ, vaṉpulattār meṉ pulattiṉkaṇ vaḻakkut toṭuppa rātalāl, ataṉip “pulavikal” eṉṟār. meṉpula viṉiñarāl pulliyavākak karutappaṭum varakum koḷḷum vaṉpulattārkku oṇ poruḷātalāl, kaḷḷiṟku avaṟṟi uyariya poruḷākak koṭuppa reṉpār, “oḷvili koṭukkum” eṉṟār. av vaḷam vīṅku irukkikaḷ veḷvarakum koḷḷum vittum karampiyāy viṭutalāl, “veḷvara kuḻuta koḷḷuṭik karampi” yeṉṟār. karampi yeṉpuḻi ātaliṉ eṉa oru col varuvikka. vaḷam vīṅkirukki, karampiyātaliṉ eṉa iyiyum. naṉṉilaṅkaḷi yaḻittuk kaḻutiyērpūṭṭi veḷvarakum koḷḷum vittutal paṇṭiyōr muṟi; “iruṅkaḷantōṟum, veḷvāyk kaḻutip pulliṉam pūṭṭi, veḷḷi varakum koḷḷum vittum, vika luḻava” (puṟam. 392) eṉṟu cāṉṟōr kūṟutal kāṇka. ivvāṟu tām irukkum irukkikaḷ karampiyāy viṭutalāl vēntar mutalāyiṉār cennel luṇaviṉṟi vaṟumiyuṟṟu valikuṉṟiṉa reṉpār, “cennel valci yaṟiyār” eṉṟum, eṉavē, avartam nāṭṭi iṉitāḷutal illi yeṉṟaṟku, “nāṭuṭa ṉāṭal yāvaṇa tavarkkē” yeṉṟum kūṟiṉār. “pāṭal cāṉṟa vippiṉ nāṭu” eṉṟatu, nāṭṭiṉ naṉmi kūṟi yiraṅkiyatu.
itukāṟuṅ kūṟiyatu: poṟiya, nī arumpoṟi vayamāṉ aṉiyi; vēntarum vēḷirum piṟarum kīḻppaṇintu niṉ vaḻippaṭārāyiṉ, avaruṭiya vaḷam vīṅkirukki, karampi yātaliṉ, cennel valci yaṟiyārāyt tattam nāṭuṭaṉāṭal avarkku yāvaṇatām eṉpatām. iṉip paḻiyavurikārar, vaṉpulantaḻīi yeṉṟu pāṭaṅ koṇṭu, ataṉik karampi yoṭu kūṭṭi, iruntu eṉa oru col varuvittu vaṉpulam taḻīi yiruntu eṉṟum, meṉpāltōṟum iruntu eṉṟum iyittu, “poṟiya, nī puli koṉṟu kaḷiṟaṭūum vayamāṉ aṉiyi; ataṉāl vēntarum vēḷirum piṟarum niṉṉaṭik kīḻp paṇintu, tamakkuriya meṉpālkaṭōṟum iruntu muṉ paṇinta vāṟṟiṟ kēṟpa niṉvaḻi yoḻukārāyiṉ, avarkaḷ veḷḷavarakuḻuta koḷḷuṭik karampiyākiya vaṉpālilē keṭṭuppō yiruntu āṇṭu viḷinta veḷvaraku uṇpataṉṟit tām paṇṭuṇṇum cennel valci uṇṇak kiṭiyātapaṭi miṭipaṭukiṉṟār; tattam nāṭṭiṉi oruṅku āḷutal avarkku yāvaṇatu eṉa viṉimuṭivu ceyka” eṉpar.
“itaṉāṟ colliyatu, avaṉ veṉṟicciṟappuk kūṟiya vāṟāyiṟṟu.”
6. mācita ṟirukki
1.	kaḷiṟuṭip peruñcaman tatiya veḵkuyart
	toḷiṟuvāṇ maṉṉar tutinili koṉṟu
	muracukaṭip paṭiya varuntuṟip pōkip
	peruṅkaṭa ṉīntiya maramvali yuṟukkum
5.	paṇṇiya viliñar pōlap puṇṇorīip
	peruṅkit toḻutiyiṉ vaṉṟuyar kaḻippi
	irantōr vāḻa nalki yirappōrk
	kīta ṟaṇṭā mācita ṟirukki
	kaṇṭaṉeṉ celku vantaṉeṉ kālkoṇṭu
10.	karuvi vāṉan taṇṭaḷi corinteṉap
	palviti yuḻaviṟ cillē rāḷar
	paṉittuṟip pakaṉṟip pāṅkuṭit teriyal
	kaḻuvuṟu kaliṅkaṅ kaṭuppac cūṭi
	ilaṅkukatirt tirumaṇi peṟūum
15.	akaṉkaṇ vippi ṉāṭukiḻa vōyē.
tuṟi	:	centuṟip pāṭāṇpāṭṭu
vaṇṇam	:	oḻuku vaṇṇam
tūkku	:	centūkku
peyar	:	mā cita ṟirukki
9-15. kāl koṇṭu ......... nāṭukiḻa vōyē
uri:
karuvi vāṉam kāl koṇṭu taṇtaḷi corinteṉa - tokuti koṇṭa maḻimēkam nāṟṟiciyum kāliṟaṅkit taṇṇiya maḻiyip peytatāka; palviti uḻaviṉ cil ērāḷar - mikutiyāka vitittaṟkēṟpap paranta uḻunilaṅkaḷi yuṭiya cilavākiya ērkaḷiyuṭiya uḻavar; paṉittuṟip pakaṉṟip pāṅkuṭit teriyal - kuḷirnta nīrttuṟi yiṭattē malarntuḷḷa pakaṉṟip pūvāṟṟoṭutta aḻakuṭiya māliyi; kaḻuvuṟu kaliṅkam kaṭuppac cūṭi - veḷukkappaṭṭa veḷḷāṭipōlat taliyiṟcūṭikkoṇṭu; ilaṅku katirt tirumaṇi peṟūum - uḻum paṭiccāliṭattē viḷaṅku kiṉṟa katirkaḷiyuṭiya aḻakiya maṇikaḷip peṟukiṉṟa; akaṉkaṇ vippiṉ nāṭu kiḻavōy - akaṉṟa iṭamuṭiya ūrkaḷ poruntiya nāṭṭukku uriyōṉē eṉṟavāṟu.
iṭi miṉṉal, maḻi mutaliyavaṟṟiṉ tokutiyātal paṟṟi, “karuvi vāṉam” eṉappaṭṭatu. maḻimukil nāṟṟiciyum paravumiṭattuk kālviṭ ṭiṟaṅkutal kaṇkūṭātaliṉ “kāl koṇṭu” eṉṟār. kālkoṇṭeṉpataṟkup pey talit toṭaṅki yeṉṟalumām. vitiyiṉ perumiyi nōkka, uḻutaṟkuriya ērkaḷ ciṟiyavātal paṟṟi, “palviti yuḻaviṟ cillē rāḷar” eṉṟār. “akala vuḻuvatiṉum āḻa vuḻutal vēṇṭumātalāl ataṟkēṟṟa perumiyuṭiya vākātu ciṟumiyuṭimipaṟṟiyē “cillērāḷar” eṉṟu kūṟal vēṇṭiṟṟu. ciṉmi, ciṟumi kuṟittu niṉṟatu. paḻiya vurikārarum, “ciṉmiyic ciṉṉū leṉṟatupōla īṇṭuc ciṟumiyākak koḷka” eṉṟār. cillērāḷar uḻuta paṭiccāl mika āḻamuṭittaṉ ṟāyiṉum, ataṉkaṇṇum avarkaḷ mikka viḷi payaṉē yaṉṟi uyariya maṇikaḷip peṟukiṉṟārka ḷeṉpār; “cillē rāḷar ilaṅkukatirt tirumaṇi peṟūum nāṭu” eṉṟār.
pakaṉṟi malarkku veḷutta āṭiyi uvami kūṟutalum, āṭikku ammalari yuvami kūṟutalum cāṉṟōr vaḻakkākum. “pōtuviri pakaṉṟip putumala raṉṉa, akaṉṟumaṭi kaliṅka muṭīic celvamum, kēṭiṉṟu nalkumati peruma” (puṟam. 393) eṉṟu nalliṟiyaṉār eṉṉum cāṉṟōr kūṟutal kāṇka. pakaṉṟiyik kaṇṇiyākat toṭuttaṇitalē perum pāṉmi vaḻakkātaliṉ, teriyaleṉṟatu kaṇṇiyeṉak koḷḷap paṭṭatu; “pakaṉṟikkaṇṇip pallāṉ kōvalar” (aiṅ. 87) eṉṟum, “pakaṉṟik kaṇṇip paḻiyar” (malipaṭu. 459) eṉṟum varutal kāṇka. calavi ceyyappaṭṭa āṭi yeṉṟaṟkuk “kaḻuvuṟu kaliṅkam” eṉṟār. uyarnta maṇiyeṉpār, “tirumaṇi” yeṉṟār. peru varuvāyuṭimi tōṉṟa, akaṉkaṇ vippiṉ nāṭu eṉṟu ciṟappikkappaṭṭatu.
iṉip paḻiyavurikārar, “taṇṭaḷi corinteṉa ērāḷar katirt tirumaṇi peṟūum nāṭu eṉak kūṭṭi, maḻi peytalāṉē ērāḷar uḻutu viḷittukkōṭalē yaṉṟi uḻuta iṭaṅkaḷ tōṟum oḷiyiyuṭiya tirumaṇikaḷi yeṭuttukkoḷḷum nāṭeṉa vurikka” eṉṟum, “palviti yuḻaviṉ cillē rāḷareṉṟatu, palaviti yuḻavāṟ periyā rāyiṉum tam kulattāṉum oḻukkattāṉum ciṟiya ērāḷa reṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “pakaṉṟit teriyal kaḻuvuṟu kaliṅkam kaṭuppac cūṭit tirumaṇi peṟūum eṉak kūṭṭi, pakaṉṟi māliyik kaḻuvuṟu kaliṅkam oppac cūṭikkoṇṭu niṉṟu tirumaṇikaḷi yeṭukkumeṉa vurikka” eṉṟum kūṟuvar.
1-9. kaḷiṟuṭip peruñcamam ........ vantaṉeṉ
uri:
